subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: Define the role of the author and the illustrator in presenting the ideas in a text. (RI&RL)
ee_text: With guidance and support, distinguish between words and illustrations/graphics in a text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can analyze how the author and illustrator use different techniques to convey meaning (e.g., author uses figurative language, illustrator uses symbolism).
I can compare and contrast the roles of the author and illustrator in different texts.
I can create my own text and illustrations that work together to communicate a message.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can explain that the author and illustrator work together to present the ideas in a text.
I can identify specific ways the author and illustrator contribute to the meaning of the text (e.g., author uses descriptive language, illustrator uses color to create mood).
I can explain how the author and illustrator's choices impact the reader's understanding of the text.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can explain that the author chooses the words and ideas in a text.
I can explain that the illustrator creates pictures that match the story.
I can identify specific ways the illustrator helps to tell the story (e.g., facial expressions, setting details).
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify the author and illustrator of a text.
I can say that the author writes the words and the illustrator draws the pictures.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify words and illustrations/graphics in a text with minimal guidance and support.
I can explain the difference between words and illustrations/graphics, even when they are presented together.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify words and illustrations/graphics in a text with some guidance and support.
I can begin to explain the difference between words and illustrations/graphics, especially when they are presented separately.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can identify words and illustrations/graphics in a text with significant guidance and support.
I am starting to understand the difference between words and illustrations/graphics, but I may still need help distinguishing them.

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: With prompting and support, describe the relationship between illustrations and the text. (RI&RL)
ee_text: With guidance and support, identify illustrations or objects/tactile information that go with the text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can explain how a picture helps me understand the characters and setting in a story.
I can compare and contrast the information in a picture with the information in the text.
I can use pictures to retell a story in my own words.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
With prompting and support, I can describe how a picture helps me understand the text.
I can explain how a picture shows what is happening in the story.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can say how a picture helps me understand the story.
I can describe one or two things that are happening in a picture.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify pictures in a book.
I can say what I see in a picture.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can independently identify illustrations, objects, or tactile information that directly relate to the text with 80% accuracy.
descriptors.ee_approaching: I can identify illustrations, objects, or tactile information that directly relate to the text with some support (e.g., prompts, cues) with 60% accuracy.
descriptors.ee_emerging: I can identify illustrations, objects, or tactile information that directly relate to the text with significant support (e.g., modeling, repetition) with 40% accuracy.

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: With prompting and support, identify specific information to support ideas in a text. (RI)
ee_text: With guidance and support, identify points the author makes in text. (RI)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can find specific information in a text to support my ideas and I can explain how the information helps my ideas.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can find specific information in a text with help from an adult.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can sometimes find information in a text with help from an adult.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can try to find information in a text with help from an adult.

I can identify some of the points the author makes in text with guidance and support.

descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can identify some of the points the author makes in text with significant support.
I can use pictures, diagrams, or other visuals to help me understand some of the points the author makes with significant support.

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: With prompting and support, compare and contrast two texts; recognize that texts reflect one’s own and others’ culture. (RI&RL)
ee_text: With guidance and support, match similar parts of two familiar texts, identifying the adventures or experiences of a character. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently compare and contrast two texts, identifying multiple similarities and differences across various elements such as main ideas, characters, settings, events, and language.
I can explain how details from a text reflect the author's culture and my own culture, and I can discuss how these cultural influences shape the story or information presented.
I can use evidence from the texts to support my comparisons and contrasts and my understanding of cultural influences.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can listen to two texts read aloud and compare and contrast their main ideas, characters, settings, or events with prompting and support.
I can recognize that texts reflect the cultures of the people who wrote them and identify details from a text that relate to the author's culture and my own culture.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can listen to two short texts read aloud and identify two similarities and one difference between them.
I can identify two details from a text that relate to my own culture and one detail that relates to another culture.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can listen to two short texts read aloud with support and identify one similarity between them.
I can identify one detail from a text that relates to my own culture with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can listen to two familiar texts read aloud and identify when the same character appears in both, even if the character has a different name or appearance.
I can explain how the character's adventures or experiences are similar in both texts, using simple sentences.
I can match pictures or objects that represent the character's adventures or experiences in each text, and explain how they are similar.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can listen to two short texts read aloud and identify when the same character appears in both, even if the character has a different name.
I can, with some support, explain how the character's adventures or experiences are similar in both texts.
I can match simple pictures or objects that represent the character's adventures or experiences in each text.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can listen to two short texts read aloud and identify when the same character appears in both.
I can, with support, point to pictures or objects that represent the character's adventures or experiences in each text.

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to compose reflective, formal, and creative writing, which may happen simultaneously or independently, for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use drawing, dictating, or writing to compose writing for a variety of high-stakes and low- stakes purposes.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can use drawing, dictation, and writing creatively and effectively to express myself in different ways.
 I can adapt my writing style and content to different audiences and purposes.
 I can use my writing to reflect on my own learning and growth.
 I can use my writing to make a positive impact on my community or the world.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can use drawing, dictation, and writing independently or together to create different types of writing (reflective, formal, creative).
 I can write complete sentences with correct spelling and punctuation most of the time.
 I can use my writing to communicate effectively for different purposes (high-stakes and low-stakes).
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can combine drawing and dictation to create short stories or descriptions.
 I can write simple sentences with some correct spelling and punctuation.
 I can use drawing or writing to reflect on my experiences or feelings.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can use drawing or dictation to share simple stories or ideas.
 I can sometimes write individual letters or words to represent my thoughts.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use drawing, dictating, or writing to compose writing for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes, with guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_approaching: I can use drawing, dictating, or writing to communicate basic information for simple purposes, with some guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_emerging: I can use drawing, dictating, or writing to express myself in simple ways, with significant guidance and support.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to compose text in a variety of modes. a. Opinion pieces in which they tell the reader the topic or the name of the book they are writing about and state an opinion or preference about the topic or book.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing, dictation and/or drawing to compose: a. Opinion pieces in which they state an opinion.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can write opinion pieces with strong arguments and supporting evidence.
 I can write informative or explanatory texts using clear organization and details.
 I can write narratives with vivid descriptions and engaging characters.
 I can use my writing to communicate effectively with others in different contexts.
 I can write for different audiences and purposes.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can write opinion pieces stating my opinion or preference about a topic or book.
 I can write informative or explanatory texts providing information about a topic.
 I can write narratives telling about real or imagined events in order.
 I can use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to create different types of texts.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can draw pictures and use words to tell a story or event.
 I can dictate sentences and short paragraphs to an adult to help me write.
 I can write simple sentences with correct letter formation and spacing.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can draw pictures to represent a story or event.
 I can dictate simple sentences to an adult to help me write.
 I can copy letters and words with some guidance.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, select a topic and use drawing, dictating, or writing to share information about the topic.
I can after choosing to write about self, looking at a picture of himself, and talking with a teacher about his features (hair, face, hands) and clothes, use drawing, dictating, writing, assistive technology, or other means of expression to state information about himself.
I can after selecting a picture of himself, looking at it, and interacting with a teacher using a multiple message voice output device with body part labels (the teacher is modeling the device and talking about the messages), use the device to dictate a list of his body parts.
I can In structured shared writing during which the teacher uses a repeated sentence frame to guide students in creating a predictable chart with a repeated line (e.g., I like____), select a topic (e.g., hot dogs) and dictate a response (e.g., “hotdogs”) for the teacher to add to the chart.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, select a topic for use in shared writing.
I can during a shared writing activity, when the teacher presents two symbols or objects that could be used to complete a sentence, select one.
I can during journaling time, when the teacher presents three photos of familiar activities or experiences, select one as the topic, then use a(n adapted) keyboard to type letters in a title space and type additional letters on the page, with which the teacher will, afterward, type, point to, and read aloud a short conventional title and three-word sample informational sentence.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, interact with objects and artifacts and produce emergent writings related to the topics that other students are writing about.
I can during a shared writing activity, interact with objects while a peer shares his/her writing and then with objects removed, observe as a peer reads and points to his/her writing a second time (e.g., A peer shares his writing which includes a picture of a dinosaur and some beginning writing. The peer also shares some toy dinosaurs from a classroom collection and the student interacts with the toy dinosaurs. The toys are removed and the peer points to the picture of the dinosaur and then points to his writing as he reads it aloud a final time.).
I can during a shared writing activity, explore objects that peers are writing about (e.g., Peers are writing about leaves they collected on a walk outside. The student uses available senses to explore his/her own leaves.), and then use (adapted) writing tools and paper or a whiteboard to engage in emergent writing behaviors.

I can write about a real or imagined event and tell what happened in the correct order.

I can describe one or two events with support.

descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can use drawing or dictation to tell a story.
 I can sometimes use simple words to describe my drawings or stories.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, select an event and use drawing, dictating, or writing to narrate information about it.
I can when given an array of photos from a class field trip, select one of the pictures, spend time talking about the event depicted in the picture with an adult or peer, and then label it verbally while the teacher writes the labels.
I can working with a teacher who is modeling how to select messages on a multiple message voice output device, select messages to dictate information about an experience during a learning center (e.g., make, big, house, kick, over, all done).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, select an event to write about during shared writing.
I can given three choices of events to write about, select one and then participate in shared writing about it.
I can given an array of photos depicting personal events, select a photo that the teacher uses as the topic for shared writing.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, choose a comment about an event or experience for an adult or peer to write down.
I can given a preprogrammed voice output communication device and encouragement to “tell us about the trip,” activate the device to say, “I had fun,” which the teacher will write down and then, while pointing word by word, read aloud.
I can shown symbols of good and great, select one of the two symbols to comment on an experience the teachers know the child enjoyed, and then select from an array of symbols with accompanying descriptive words ideas that accompany that judgment (e.g., hot, tired, thirsty, sleepy if they select bad).

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Word Choice (including domain specific): Use words familiar to the student.
ee_text: Not applicable

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can use a wide variety of familiar and domain-specific words that clearly describe what I am writing about.
I can choose words carefully to make my writing interesting and clear, even using new words I have learned recently.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can use familiar words to talk about what I am writing, including some domain-specific words that are related to my topic.
I can use words that help my reader understand what I am writing about.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can use some familiar words in my writing, but I need help to use domain-specific words related to the topic.
I can choose words to describe what I am writing about, but I may need support to make my word choices clearer.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can use a few familiar words in my writing with support, but I need help to include more words or describe my topic clearly.
I can with support use domain-specific words or choose words that match what I am trying to say.
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: With guidance and support from adults, use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to compose text in which the development and organization are culturally-sustaining and rhetorically authentic to task and purpose. (Grade-specific expectations for writing types are defined in standards 1-3 above.)
ee_text: (Begins in grade 3)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can draw, tell and write a short piece for a clear purpose and explain who it is for.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can, with help from an adult, draw, tell and write to make a piece that fits my task and purpose.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can draw a picture and tell an adult about it to share an idea with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can make marks or choose a picture to share an idea with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: (Begins in grade 3)

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: With guidance and support from adults, respond to questions and suggestions from peers and add details to strengthen writing as needed.
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, add more information to their own drawing, dictation, or writing to strengthen it.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently respond to questions and suggestions from peers and use their feedback to improve my writing.
 I can independently add details to my writing to make it more interesting and informative, even without adult support.
 I can use my writing to communicate effectively with others in different situations, such as writing a letter to a friend or creating a story for my classmates.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can respond to questions and suggestions from peers with guidance and support from adults.
 I can add details to my writing to strengthen it, with guidance and support from adults.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can respond to simple questions and suggestions from peers with some adult support.
 I can add some details to my writing with some help from adults.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can attempt to respond to questions and suggestions from peers with some adult support.
 I can try to add details to my writing, but I may need significant help from adults.
descriptors.ee_at_target: EE Emerging I can add one or two simple details to my drawing, dictation, or writing with help from an adult. I can repeat information from my drawing, dictation, or writing with prompting. EE Approaching I can add three or more details to my drawing, dictation, or writing with some help from an adult. I can retell information from my drawing, dictation, or writing in my own words with support. EE At Target I can add details to my drawing, dictation, or writing to make it more interesting and informative with guidance from an adult. I can retell information from my drawing, dictation, or writing in my own words with clear details.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: With guidance and support from adults, explore a variety of digital tools to produce and publish writing, including in collaboration with peers. Learn to produce writing through printing (including forming most printed upper- and lower-case letters), cursive, or typing.
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, explore a variety of digital tools to produce individual or group writing. With guidance and support from adults, produce writing through printing (including letter- like marks or forming some printed letters).

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently choose and use appropriate digital tools to write for different purposes.
 I can write and publish my work in a variety of formats, such as ebooks, blogs, and videos.
 I can use digital tools to share my writing with others and get feedback.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can use a variety of digital tools to write, such as drawing, typing, and recording audio.
 I can print most uppercase and lowercase letters independently.
 I can collaborate with peers to write and publish our work using digital tools.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can use some digital tools to write with adult support, such as drawing or typing simple words.
 I can print most uppercase and lowercase letters with some guidance.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can explore digital tools with adult support, but I need help understanding how to use them for writing.
 I can print some letters and words with guidance, but I still need help forming them correctly.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, explore a variety of digital tools to produce writing that is published.
I can work with an adult who models the use of the touchscreen on a computer or tablet device, touch the screen to select letters or words, and then upload the final product to an Internet-based, class publishing environment.
I can work with peers who model how to use drawing or painting software, use a variety of digital drawing and painting tools to produce writing, which is then printed and incorporated into a class book.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, explore a variety of digital tools and print products.
I can work with an adult who models the use of the touchscreen on a computer or tablet device, touch and visually attend to the screen then interact with the printed product.
I can work with peers who model how to use drawing or painting software, use a variety of digital drawing and painting tools to make marks.
I can explore word banks and an alphabet in multimedia writing software to produce a text, which is uploaded by the teacher to the class Internet-based publishing environment.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, explore various means of accessing digital tools, and print, save, and display the product in the class or on the Internet.
I can activate a switch to scan through the letters of the alphabet and have the product printed and saved in their writing folder.
I can touch, bang, or swipe over the surface of an alternative keyboard so the product can be printed and hung on the class writing bulletin board.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Participate in shared inquiry and writing projects (e.g., explore a number of books by a favorite author and express opinions about them).
ee_text: With guidance and support, participate in shared inquiry and writing projects.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can lead shared inquiry and writing projects about books.
 I can ask thoughtful questions about books and engage in discussions with others.
 I can write creatively about books, using my imagination and knowledge.
 I can apply my understanding of books to real-life situations, such as recommending books to friends or writing book reviews.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can actively participate in shared inquiry and writing projects about books.
 I can ask and answer questions about books, sharing my own ideas and opinions.
 I can collaborate with others to write about books, following simple guidelines.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can ask and answer simple questions about books.
 I can share my own opinions and ideas about books with some support.
 I can participate in collaborative writing projects with guidance from adults.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can listen to others share their ideas and opinions about books.
 I can participate in simple discussions about books with guidance from adults.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, participate in shared research and writing projects.
I can given a book on a topic related to a shared reading project and guidance in finding a page with pictures related to the research topic, identifying pictures that relate to the shared research and writing project.
I can given a pre-made software set-up with banks of words and pictures related to a shared research and writing project and, select words and pictures to contribute to the shared product.
I can select the topic of the research project and choose words or ideas to include pictures and word banks.
I can read and listen with a peer to talking books selected by the teacher in a digital reading environment and with a keyboard with alphabet and whole word access, type letters, words, or sentences about what they learn.
I can type letters as they are dictated by a peer and then dictate known letters to a peer to add content to a shared writing project.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, participate in selecting pictures and words to contribute to shared research and writing projects.
I can with guidance and support from the teacher, select from a bank of words and pictures on an interactive whiteboard to contribute to writing a shared research project.
I can with guidance and support from the teacher who has selected a website with words and pictures about the research project, point to pictures and words to contribute to writing the shared research project.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, explore pictures, words, or objects related to a shared research project.
I can, given a multimedia presentation of words and pictures related to a shared research project, use a switch to advance through the pictures looking and/or listening to the words and pictures, and select one which a peer, aide, or teacher will write in the shared research project.
I can use a touchscreen to scroll through pictures related to the topic of a shared research project and select one which a peer, aide, or teacher will write in the shared research project.
I can explore a bin full of objects and artifacts related to a shared research project, and select one which a peer, aide, or teacher will write in the shared research project.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: With guidance and support from adults, recall information from experiences or gather information from provided sources to answer a question.
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, identify information, objects, or events that relate to personal experiences.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can remember details from past experiences and use them to answer complex questions.
 I can independently gather information from multiple sources to answer questions and solve problems.
 I can use the information I have learned to make predictions about what might happen in the future.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can remember information from my own experiences and use it to answer questions.
 I can gather information from books or other sources to answer questions with guidance from adults.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can remember some things that happened to me before and tell others about them.
 I can listen to a story and answer simple questions about it without always needing help from adults.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can try to remember things that happened to me before, but I might need help from adults to remember details.
 I can listen to a story and answer simple questions about it with help from adults.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support from adults, identify information, objects, or events that relate to personal experiences.
I can with guidance and support, select an object to include in a shared writing activity (e.g., During a shared writing activity that requires students to identify one thing they do at home to complete a sentence, At home, I like to play _____, select a toy from an array of objects gathered by the teacher).
I can with guidance and support, select a picture to include in a shared writing activity (e.g., During a shared writing activity that involves completing a page for a class-made book, select a picture from an array of pictures of ice cream to illustrate her own page that says I like to eat ice cream).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support from adults during shared writing activities, select personal objects from an array of choices to be included in a text.
I can with guidance and support, select a color to fill in a blank in a sentence during a shared writing activity (e.g., select a color from a selection to fill in the blank in this sentence: I have a red backpack).
I can with guidance and support, put own name onto a project during a shared writing activity (e.g., select his art project from the rack and then attempt to write his name on it following a teacher model if needed).
I can Use a picture/label schedule to identify the next activity of the day.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support from adults during shared writing activities, interact with familiar objects that are being offered as choices in a text.
I can during a shared writing activity that requires children to identify the leaf they found and describe it to complete a sentence, interact with an assortment of leaves collected by the class to have their sentence and leaf (e.g., I like this leaf) added to a multimedia product.
I can during snack time, use a menu with two pictured and written choices to select a desired snack.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: With guidance and support from adults, recall facts from literary and informational text to research characters, setting, key detail, specified information, and ideas presented in a text.
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, recall key details from literary or informational texts.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can remember important facts and details from a story or book, even without help from a grown-up.
 I can use the information I remember to answer questions about the story, talk about the characters and setting, and make predictions about what might happen next.
 I can use the information I remember from different stories and books to compare and contrast them.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can remember important facts from a story or book, with some help from a grown-up.
 I can remember the names of the main characters, where and when the story takes place, and some important details about the story.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can remember some important things I learned from a story or book, with help from a grown-up.
 I can usually remember the names of the main characters in a story and where the story takes place.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can try to remember some things I learned from a story or book, with help from a grown-up.
 I can sometimes remember the names of some characters in a story.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can, with guidance, recall key details from a story or informational text I have read or listened to.
I can share at least two important details from the text with support.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can, with some support, remember one key detail from a story or informational text.
I need help to recall more than one important detail from the text.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with support remember something from a story or text, but I need help to understand what details are important.
I can share one simple idea from the text with help.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: With guidance and support, participate in collaborative conversations with diverse partners about topics and texts with peers and adults in small and larger groups. a. Follow agreed-upon norms and participate by actively listening, taking turns, and staying on topic.
ee_text: With guidance and support, participate in conversations with others. a. Communicate directly with supportive adults or peers.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can participate in conversations independently and initiate discussions with peers and adults.
 I can actively listen to others, ask questions, and contribute to the conversation.
 I can take turns speaking and ensure everyone has a chance to participate.
 I can stay on topic and guide the conversation when needed.
 I can apply these conversation skills in real-life situations, such as group projects or discussions at home.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can participate in conversations with guidance and support and follow agreed-upon norms.
 I can listen to others attentively and stay focused.
 I can take turns speaking and wait for my turn patiently.
 I can stay on topic throughout the conversation.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can participate in conversations with some support and generally follow agreed-upon norms.
 I can listen to others for longer periods and am less easily distracted.
 I can take turns speaking and rarely interrupt others.
 I can stay on topic with some reminders.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can participate in conversations with some support, but I may not always follow agreed-upon norms.
 I can listen to others for short periods but may get distracted easily.
 I can take turns speaking but may interrupt others sometimes.
 I can stay on topic with some support.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can communicate directly with peers.
I can communicate directly with a peer when addressed.
I can greet your neighbor.
I can tell a peer what his or her favorite animal is when asked.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support from an adult, participate in communication exchanges with peers.
I can ask what a peer brought for lunch as instructed by the teacher (e.g., The teacher instructs the student to ask classmates if they are buying a school lunch today).
I can respond to a peer’s question about a favorite animal as instructed by the teacher.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support of an adult, share information with a peer.
I can repeat information stated by the teacher to a peer (e.g., Teacher says, “We went to lunch. Jim, tell Perry where we went.” Students respond, “lunch.”).

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Participate in a conversation through multiple exchanges.
ee_text: Participate in multiple-turn communication exchanges with support from adults.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can initiate and participate in conversations with others, even if they are unfamiliar.
 I can use a variety of language features, such as humor, figurative language, and complex sentence structures, to enhance my communication.
 I can adjust my communication style to fit the situation and audience.
 I can use my conversations to build relationships and learn new things.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can participate in a conversation with multiple exchanges, taking turns speaking and listening.
 I can ask and answer questions, share information, and express my opinions.
 I can use appropriate language and stay on topic.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can take turns speaking and listening in a conversation with two or more people.
 I can ask and answer simple questions using complete sentences.
 I can stay on topic during a conversation.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can take turns speaking and listening in a conversation with one other person.
 I can respond to simple questions with one or two words.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can participate in multiple-turn communication exchanges with adults.
I can Listen when the teacher speaks and communicate responses when addressed by the teacher.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can communicate directly with an adult.
I can answer a Yes/No question from an adult.
I can make a choice when presented with two or more options.
I can Initiate a greeting when the teacher enters the room.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, communicate directly with an adult.
I can use gestures, vocalizations, or make eye contact with an adult to communicate a reaction or need.
I can call an adult’s name to gain his/her attention.
I can respond to greetings and farewells initiated by an adult.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Ask questions about the topic or text.
ee_text: Respond to questions about the topic or text.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can ask open-ended questions that require critical thinking.
 I can ask questions to analyze a text or situation.
 I can ask questions to generate new ideas or solutions.
 I can use my questions to lead a discussion or debate.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can ask focused questions about a specific part of a picture or story.
 I can ask questions to learn more about a topic.
 I can ask questions to compare and contrast different things.
 I can ask questions to solve a problem.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can ask multiple questions about a picture or story.
 I can ask questions about a familiar topic using who, what, where, and why.
 I can ask questions to clarify my understanding of a topic.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can ask one question about a picture or story.
 I can ask simple questions about a familiar topic.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can answer simple questions about the topic or text using complete sentences.
I can use context clues from the text to answer questions.
I can identify the main idea of the text and answer questions related to it.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can answer simple questions about the topic or text using single words or short phrases.
I can identify some details from the text and answer questions about them.
I can retell the story or event in my own words.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can answer simple questions about the topic or text by pointing or nodding.
I can identify some pictures or objects in the text.
I can listen to the story or event and participate in simple activities related to it.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Consider individual differences when communicating with others.
ee_text: Consider individual differences when communicating with others.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can actively seek out information about different cultures and perspectives.
 I can use my understanding of individual differences to build strong relationships with people from diverse backgrounds.
 I can advocate for inclusive communication practices that value and respect all individuals.
 I can use my communication skills to promote understanding and cooperation between people with different backgrounds and perspectives.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can consider individual differences when communicating with others, such as their age, gender, personality, abilities, and cultural backgrounds.
 I can adjust my communication style to effectively communicate with different people.
 I can use different communication strategies to ensure understanding and respect individual needs and preferences.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify several different ways that people are different, such as personality, abilities, and cultural backgrounds.
 I can adjust my communication style to better understand and be understood by others who are different from me.
 I can ask questions to learn more about someone's individual needs and preferences.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify basic differences between people, such as age or gender.
 I can use simple language to communicate with others, even if they are different from me.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can adjust my communication style based on the person I am talking to, such as using simpler language with younger children or speaking more slowly with someone who has difficulty understanding.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify some individual differences that might affect how someone understands me, such as age or disability.
I can sometimes adjust my communication style based on the person I am talking to, but I need reminders or support to do this consistently.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I am aware that people are different and may have different needs.
I am starting to learn about how individual differences can affect communication.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: With guidance and support, ask and answer questions about key details in a text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media.
ee_text: With guidance and support, demonstrate an emerging understanding of a familiar text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media by answering questions

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can listen to a text or presentation and identify key details independently.
I can ask and answer complex questions about key details in a text or presentation independently.
I can use the information I learn from texts and presentations to answer questions about my own life and experiences.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can listen to a text or presentation and identify key details with guidance and support from an adult.
I can ask and answer questions about key details in a text or presentation with guidance and support from an adult.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can listen to a text or presentation and identify several key details with support from an adult.
I can ask and answer simple questions about a text or presentation with some help from an adult
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can listen to a short text or presentation and identify one or two key details with support from an adult.
I can ask simple questions about a text or presentation with help from an adult
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can demonstrate anEE Emerging understanding of a familiar text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media by answering questions.
I can answer yes/no questions about details presented in a story read aloud to them.
I can answer a question about a detail presented in a story read aloud to them (through gestures, vocalizations, eye contact or gaze).
I can, after lunch menu is read, the student answers question about what the lunch will be for the day.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, demonstrate anEE Emerging understanding of a familiar text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media by answering questions.
I can after listening to a weather report, answer questions about the day’s weather by selecting from two symbols.
I can after listening to a story, choose symbols (e.g., yes, no, maybe) in response to the question “Did you like the story?”
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can attend to a familiar text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media.
I can watch a segment of Planet Earth during a science lesson.
I can attend to speaker at school assembly.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Ask and answer questions in order to seek help, get information, or clarify something that is not understood.
ee_text: Ask for help when needed.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can ask and answer complex questions about a variety of topics.
I can use sophisticated vocabulary and sentence structures when asking and answering questions.
I can ask and answer questions to further my understanding of a topic.
I can use questioning strategies to engage in discussions and debates.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can ask and answer questions in order to seek help, get information, or clarify something that is not understood.
 I can ask questions using complete sentences and appropriate grammar.
 I can answer questions using complete sentences, providing relevant and accurate information.
 I can ask and answer questions about a variety of topics, including unfamiliar ones.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can ask questions using complete sentences, but may need support to formulate questions clearly.
 I can answer questions using complete sentences, but may need support to provide complete or relevant information.
 I can ask and answer questions about familiar topics.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can ask simple questions using single words or short phrases.
 I can answer simple questions with single words or short phrases.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can ask for help when needed.
I can indicate a need for help by raising hand, hitting switch, etc.
I can indicate yes/no when asked, “Do you understand?” or “Do you have any questions?”
I can indicate a need for assistance through gestures, eye contact or gaze, vocalizations, etc.
I can use voice or a multiple message communication system, ask a question for clarification or more information (e.g., “Why?,” “What’s that?,” “Who did that?,” “Where is it?”).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, ask for help when needed.
I can indicate yes/no when asked, “Do you need help?”
I can when prompted, uses appropriate gestures, eye contact or gaze, vocalizations, etc. to ask for help.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can indicate distress.
I can cry, gesture, or vocalize to indicate distress.
I can activate an audio “Help” switch.

source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

subject: ELA
cluster: Presentation of Knowledge & Ideas
text: With guidance and support, describe familiar people, places, things, and events.
ee_text: With guidance and support, identify familiar people, places, things, and events.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently describe familiar people, places, things, and events in detail and using vivid language.
I can use descriptive words and phrases to create a clear picture in the listener's mind.
I can use my descriptions to share my experiences and connect with others
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can describe familiar people, places, things, and events using complete sentences and relevant details.
 I can use descriptive language to share my observations and experiences.
 I can answer questions about what I have described.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can describe familiar people, places, things, and events using simple sentences and some details.
 I can use some descriptive words to share my observations and experiences.
 I can answer simple questions about what I have described.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify familiar people, places, things, and events.
 I can use single words or short phrases to describe them.
 I can answer basic questions about what I have described.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, identify familiar people, places, things, and events.
I can identify a specific person by pointing or naming when asked (e.g., “Who is your teacher?”).
I can identify the name of objects from choices (e.g., “Is this a pencil or a crayon?”).
I can name activity or point to correct icon on schedule when asked, “What’s next?”
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, respond to familiar people and things.
I can respond to familiar people when they are in front of the student (e.g., “Billie, look at this teacher.”).
I can respond to familiar objects when placed in front of the student (e.g., “Tom, where is your book?”).
descriptors.ee_emerging:

subject: ELA

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently ask and answer questions about the meaning of unfamiliar words, using context clues and my own knowledge.
 I can identify and explain similes, metaphors, and other figures of speech with minimal support from adults.
 I can use figurative language in my own writing and speaking to create vivid descriptions and enhance my communication.
 I can recognize and explain the different shades of meaning that words can have, depending on the context.
 I can use my understanding of word relationships and nuances in meaning to interpret texts and solve problems.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can ask and answer questions about the meaning of unfamiliar words with support from adults.
 I can identify and point to pictures that represent the meaning of words with multiple meanings.

I can, with some support from adults, ask simple questions about the meaning of unfamiliar words.

descriptors.ee_at_target:

descriptors.ee_approaching:

descriptors.ee_emerging:

subject: ELA

I can after hearing a story for the first time, tells the teacher how the main character was feeling: sad, happy, mad, hungry, tired, etc.
I can after reading The Very Hungry Caterpillar, pick hungry from three options when asked, “How was the caterpillar feeling?”
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify sensory or feeling words in a familiar story.
I can while listening to a familiar story, signal when a feeling word is read.
I can given a familiar picture book that includes illustrations that depict a feeling (e.g., Today, I Feel Silly and Other Moods That Make My Day), identify the feeling depicted.

I can choose from two pictures to identify a sensory or feeling word from the story.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, imitate, act out, or otherwise gesture to demonstrate a sensory or feeling word that is used in a familiar text.
I can with guidance and support, imitate facial expressions to match the feelings in the text, Today, I Feel Silly and Other Moods That Make My Day.
I can with guidance and support, wave a finger to match the words Mrs. Wishy Washy says when she tells each animal, “In the tub you go!”

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Compose reflective, formal, and creative writing, which may happen simultaneously or independently, for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use drawing, dictating, or writing to compose writing for a variety of high-stakes and low- stakes purposes.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write different types of texts, including stories, letters, and reflections, using creativity and proper form, and explain why I chose a particular type of writing for different situations.

I can select a selected topic or book and use drawing, dictating, or writing to state an opinion about it.
I can select a book from a collection offered by the teacher and express an opinion about it by writing.
I can given the directions to write about a favorite book, select a book from the classroom library and type letters on an alternate keyboard to write about it.
I can during independent writing, select a familiar book from a selection of three offered by the teacher and write letters to express an opinion about it.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can select a book and use drawing, dictating, or writing to state an opinion about it.
I can Select a book from a collection offered by the teacher and express an opinion about it by drawing a picture of a happy face.
I can In structured shared writing during which the teacher uses a repeated sentence frame to guide students in creating a predictable chart with the repeated line, I like <type of animal> because they are <descriptor>, the student will select a picture of their favorite animal to communicate which animal they like and then select from an array of possible adjectives reasons why (e.g., “I like <panthers> because they are <strong>.”).

I can select a book from a basket of books, look at it, and, given access to a feelings page of emotion symbols, indicate an opinion about the book that the teacher will write.

subject: ELA

I can select a topic and use drawing, dictating, or writing to share information about it.

The dog is brown.).
