subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose in conventions with: c. spell grade-level words correctly using reference materials to solve words and edit written work as needed.
ee_text: Spell untaught word phonetically, drawing on letter-sound relationships and common spelling patterns.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can read grade-level text aloud with great accuracy, appropriate pacing, and strong expression, making the text sound natural and engaging (e.g., "I used different tones for each character’s dialogue and paused correctly at commas").
I can improve my reading each time I practice, making fewer mistakes and adding more expression (e.g., "After practising, I read the speech aloud with the right speed and enthusiasm").
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can read grade-level text aloud with good accuracy, rate, and expression (e.g., "I read the story at a steady pace and changed my voice to match the mood").
I can improve my accuracy and expression after reading a text a few times (e.g., "When I practised, I used more expression and read with fewer mistakes").
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can read aloud with some accuracy and expression but may need help adjusting my speed (e.g., "I read the text aloud but needed help slowing down during longer sentences").
I can improve my reading with practice and guidance (e.g., "I read the paragraph better after practising with help to pause at commas").
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can read aloud with help and improve my speed and expression with practice (e.g., "With help, I read the sentence more smoothly and used a happy tone for the characters").
I can read more clearly and expressively after practising multiple times with guidance (e.g., "I practiced reading the story and used better pauses and emotion").
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can spell new words by sounding them out, using what I know about letter sounds and spelling patterns.
I can use what I know about letters and sounds to spell words that I haven’t learned yet.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can try to spell words I don’t know by saying the sounds I hear with help.
I can write some letters that match the sounds of a word with guidance.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can listen to a word and say or write one of the sounds I hear with support.
I can use pictures or letters to show how a word sounds with help.

descriptors_suggested.cc_at_target: I can spell grade-level words correctly, using reference materials to solve words and edit my writing.
descriptors_suggested.cc_approaching: I can spell common words correctly and use a dictionary or spell-checker with support.
descriptors_suggested.cc_emerging: I can spell a few familiar words and copy others from a word wall with help.
descriptors_suggested.ee_at_target: I can spell untaught words by sounding them out and using common spelling patterns.

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: Cite textual evidence to support an analysis of what the text says explicitly or implicitly and make logical inferences. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Determine what a text says explicitly as well as what simple inferences should be drawn. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can cite several pieces of strong evidence and explain how each one supports my inference about a text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can cite text evidence to support what a text says directly and the logical inferences I make.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can point to a sentence in the text that supports an answer when my teacher gives me a sentence starter.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can answer simple who, what and where questions using words I find in the text with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can find what a text says and make a simple inference from it.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: Summarize texts, from a variety of genres, to determine a theme or central idea and how it is developed by key supporting details over the course of a text. (RI &RL)
ee_text: Determine details in a text that are related to the theme or main idea. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write an objective summary and explain how several key details work together to develop the theme or central idea.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can summarize a text and explain how key supporting details develop its theme or central idea.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can retell the main events or facts and name the central idea using a graphic organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what a short text is mostly about using pictures or a word bank with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can find details in a text that connect to the theme or main idea.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: In literary texts, describe how events unfold, as well as how characters respond or change as the plot moves toward a resolution. (RL) In informational texts, analyze how individuals, events, and ideas are introduced, related to each other, and developed. (RI)
ee_text: In literary texts, identify how a character responds to a challenge in a text. (RL) In informational texts, identify a detail that elaborates upon individuals, events, or ideas introduced in a text. (RI)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how a character's changes or an idea's development shape the meaning of the whole text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can describe how a plot unfolds and how characters change, and explain how people, events and ideas are introduced and developed in informational text.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can put the main events of a story in order and say how a character feels or changes with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can name the characters and one event in a story or one key person or event in a text with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell how a character responds to a problem or find a detail that tells more about a person, event or idea.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: Determine the meaning of words and phrases, including figurative and connotative meanings. Analyze the impact of specific word choices on meaning, tone, and mood, including words with multiple meanings within a text. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Determine how word choice changes the meaning in a text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can explain how an author's word choices, including figurative and connotative language, create a specific tone or mood across a text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can determine the meaning of words, including figurative and connotative meanings, and explain how word choice affects meaning, tone and mood.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use context clues to work out what a word or phrase means and say if it feels positive or negative with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can match a new word to its meaning using a picture or word bank with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell how a changed word changes the meaning of a sentence or text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: In literary texts, analyze how a sentence, paragraph, stanza, chapter, scene, or section fits into the overall structure and how it contributes to the development of theme, central idea, setting, or plot. (RL) In informational texts, analyze how a particular sentence, paragraph, chapter, or section fits into the overall structure of a text and how it contributes to the development of theme or central ideas. (RI)
ee_text: Given guidance and support determine the structure of a text (e.g., story, poem, drama, argument, directions, informational). (RI &RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can compare how two texts use structure differently and explain how each structure shapes the theme or central idea.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can analyze how a sentence, paragraph, chapter, scene or section fits into the structure of a text and helps develop its theme, central idea, setting or plot.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell where a part of the text belongs (beginning, middle or end) and say what it adds with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can sort texts into story, poem or information text with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, tell the structure of a text, such as story, poem, drama, argument, directions or information.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: In literary texts, identify possible biases, the point of view, and explain how it is developed and conveys meaning in diverse texts. (RL) In informational texts, explain how an author’s geographic location, identity, or culture affect perspective. Analyze how the author distinguishes his or her position from that of others. (RI)
ee_text: With guidance and support, identify words or phrases in the text that describe or show the narrator, speaker, or author’s point of view. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how an author's background and possible bias shape a text and compare it with another author's view of the same topic.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can identify point of view and possible bias in literary texts and explain how an author's location, identity or culture affects perspective in informational texts.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell who is telling a story or what the author thinks about a topic using clue words with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell whether a story is told by a character or a narrator with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, find words or phrases that show the narrator's, speaker's or author's point of view.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas

ee_text: Find similarities in information presented in different media or formats as well as in text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate which format (print, audio, video or digital) best helps an audience understand a subject and explain why.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can compare and contrast how print and digital formats each help me understand a subject.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can list what I learned from a text and from a video on the same subject using a chart with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to the same fact in a text and in a picture or video with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can find information that is the same in a text and in another media format.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Trace and evaluate the development of an argument and specific claims in texts, distinguishing claims that are supported by reasons and relevant evidence from claims that are not. (RI)
ee_text: Distinguish claims in a text supported by reason. (RI)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate how well an argument is built and explain which claims are strongest and weakest and why.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can trace an argument and its claims, and tell which claims are supported by reasons and evidence and which are not.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find the author's main claim and one reason that supports it using a graphic organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what the author wants me to think or do with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell which claims in a text are supported by a reason.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Evaluate the quality of texts. Make connections to other texts, ideas, cultural perspectives, identities, eras, and personal experiences. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Compare and contrast how two texts describe details and make connections to other texts, ideas, cultural perspectives, identities, eras, or personal experiences. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can develop my own criteria to judge the quality of texts and connect them to other texts, cultures, eras and my own life.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can evaluate the quality of a text and make connections to other texts, ideas, cultural perspectives, identities, eras and my own experiences.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can say whether I liked a text and give one reason, and connect it to another text or my life with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell how a story is like something in my own life using pictures or sentence starters.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can compare how two texts describe details and connect them to other texts, ideas, cultures or my own experiences.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Compose reflective, formal, and creative writing, which may happen simultaneously or independently, for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use drawing, dictating, or writing to compose writing for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose the best form (reflective, formal or creative) for different purposes and explain my choice.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write reflective, formal and creative pieces for both high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write a short piece for a given purpose using a model and sentence frames.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can draw, dictate or write a few words to share an idea with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, draw, dictate or write to share my ideas for different purposes.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Write text in a variety of modes. a. Write arguments to support claims with clear reasons, relevant evidence, and literary theory.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing and/or dictation to write in a variety of modes: a. Write an argument with a clearly stated claim about a topic and include clear reasons to support that claim.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write an argument that supports a claim with strong reasons and evidence and responds to an opposing view.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write an argument that supports a claim with clear reasons and relevant evidence.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can state my opinion and give one or two reasons using an organizer and sentence frames.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can say or write what I think about a topic and why with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate a clear claim about a topic and give clear reasons for it.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Write text in a variety of modes. b. Write informative texts to examine a topic and convey ideas, concepts, and information through the selection, organization, and analysis of relevant content.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing and/or dictation to write in a variety of modes: b. Write informative texts which introduce a topic and provide facts, details, and/or multimedia content to develop the topic.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write an informative text that analyzes a topic in depth, using well-chosen facts, formatting and visuals.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write an informative text that examines a topic and conveys ideas and information by choosing and organizing relevant content.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write a short paragraph about a topic with a topic sentence and facts using a frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can share facts about a topic using words, pictures or dictation with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate an informative text that introduces a topic and gives facts and details.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Write text in a variety of modes. c. Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective narrative techniques, relevant descriptive details, and well-structured event sequences.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing and/or dictation to write in a variety of modes: c. Write narratives to convey events and experiences, real or imagined. d. Include dialogue, details regarding what happened, and tell about the events in the order in which they occurred.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write a narrative with dialogue, pacing and vivid description that keeps the reader engaged.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write a narrative about real or imagined events using narrative techniques, descriptive details and a clear sequence of events.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write a short story with a beginning, middle and end using a story map.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell or draw what happened first, next and last with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate a narrative that tells events in order and includes details.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Create writing that utilizes: a. Organization: Introduce a topic; organize ideas, concepts, and information. Provide a concluding statement appropriate to the mode of writing.
ee_text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating and writing to create a text that includes an introduction, body, and conclusion, uses words that convey specific details, transitions to link and build connections, and temporal words to signal event order.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can organize complex ideas so each part builds on the last and end with a conclusion that adds insight.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can introduce a topic, organize ideas and information, and write a conclusion that fits the mode of writing.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use a graphic organizer to plan an introduction, body and conclusion.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can put my ideas in order (first, then, last) with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, create a text with an introduction, body and conclusion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Create writing that utilizes: b. Transitions: Use appropriate transitions to clarify the relationships among ideas and concepts.
ee_text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating and writing to create a text that includes an introduction, body, and conclusion, uses words that convey specific details, transitions to link and build connections, and temporal words to signal event order.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose varied transitions that clearly show how complex ideas connect.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use appropriate transitions to show how ideas and concepts are related.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can add transitions such as first, next, because and finally from a word bank.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use simple linking words such as and or then with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use transitions and time-order words to link my ideas.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Create writing that utilizes: c. Word Choice (including domain specific): Use precise language and domain-specific vocabulary to inform about or explain the topic. Use sensory language to describe experiences and events.
ee_text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating and writing to create a text that includes an introduction, body, and conclusion, uses words that convey specific details, transitions to link and build connections, and temporal words to signal event order.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose precise, domain-specific and sensory words to make my writing vivid and exact.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use precise language and domain-specific vocabulary to explain a topic and sensory language to describe experiences.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can replace general words with more exact words from a word bank with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use labels and simple describing words to tell about a picture or topic.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use words that give specific details.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: Independently and collaboratively produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are culturally-sustaining and rhetorically authentic to task, purpose, and audience. (Grade-specific expectations for writing types are defined in standards 1-3 above.)
ee_text: Produce writing that is appropriate for the task, purpose, or audience.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can adapt the style and organization of my writing for different tasks, purposes and audiences and explain my choices.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can independently and with others produce clear writing whose development, organization and style fit the task, purpose and audience.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can produce writing that fits a task when I use a model or checklist.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can write or dictate a few sentences on a topic with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can produce writing that fits the task, purpose or audience.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach.
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults and peers, plan before writing and produce writing focused on the planned topic, and revise and edit their own writing, dictation, or pictures.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can independently revise my writing using feedback and explain how my changes make it stronger.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can, with some help from peers and adults, plan, revise, edit and rewrite to strengthen my writing.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can make one or two changes to my writing using a revision checklist and teacher feedback.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can fix a capital letter or add a word when an adult points to it.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, plan my writing and revise and edit it.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: Use technology, (including paper and pencil, internet, audio, visual, multilingual, multimodal, mobile, or other interactive formats), to produce and publish writing and present the relationships between information and ideas efficiently, as well as, to interact and collaborate with others. Proficiently produce writing through printing, cursive, or typing (with sufficient command of keyboarding skills to type a minimum of three pages in a single sitting), selecting the method(s) best suited for audience and purpose.
ee_text: Use digital tools, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing while interacting and collaborating with others. Produce writing through printing, cursive, and/or typing.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose the best technology for my audience and use it to publish and collaborate efficiently.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use technology to produce and publish writing, show how ideas connect and collaborate with others, and type at least three pages in one sitting.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can type and publish a short piece using a template with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use a device to type or record a few words with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use digital tools to produce and publish writing and work with others.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Conduct short inquiry projects to answer a question, drawing on several sources and refocusing the inquiry when appropriate.
ee_text: With guidance and support, conduct short inquiry projects to answer a question.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can design my own inquiry question and refocus my research as I learn more from several sources.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can conduct short inquiry projects to answer a question using several sources and refocus when needed.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can answer a research question using two given sources and a note-taking frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find one fact about a topic in a book or website with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, conduct a short inquiry project to answer a question.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources, assess the credibility of each source, quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and providing basic bibliographic information for sources.
ee_text: Gather information about a given topic from multiple print or digital sources.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can judge the credibility of sources and smoothly blend quotes and paraphrases with full citations.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can gather information from print and digital sources, assess their credibility, quote or paraphrase without plagiarizing, and give basic source information.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can take notes from two sources in my own words and list the titles with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can copy a fact and the title of the book or website it came from with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can gather information about a topic from several print or digital sources.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis, reflection, and inquiry. (Apply grade 6 Reading standards)
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support reflection or inquiry questions based on a reading of a literary or informational text.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose the strongest evidence from texts and explain how it supports my analysis or reflection.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis, reflection and inquiry.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find a quote that supports my answer using a sentence starter.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to a picture or sentence that matches my idea with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use evidence from a text to support my reflection or answer an inquiry question.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. a. Come to discussions prepared and explicitly draw on that preparation by referring to evidence on the topic, text, or issue. Support analysis by making connections, paraphrasing, clarifying, or explaining the evidence.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. a. Come to discussions prepared to share information, with evidence.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can come to discussions with well-chosen evidence and use it to explain and extend my peers' ideas.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can come to discussions prepared and refer to evidence, making connections, paraphrasing or explaining to support analysis.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can bring notes to a discussion and share one piece of evidence using a sentence frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can share a picture or fact I prepared when asked with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can come to discussions prepared to share information and evidence.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. b. With guidance and support, set specific norms and goals for collegial discussions (e.g., gaining attention in respectful ways, actively listening, speaking one at a time about the topics and texts under discussion).
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. b. With guidance and support from adults and peers, follow simple, agreed-upon norms for discussions and contribute information.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can help my group create norms and goals and remind others to follow them respectfully.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can, with guidance, set specific norms and goals for discussions and follow them.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can follow class discussion norms such as taking turns when reminded.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can listen and wait for my turn with adult support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, follow simple discussion norms and contribute information.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. c. Pose and respond to specific questions with elaboration and detail by making comments that contribute to the topic, text, or issue under discussion.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. c. Ask and answer questions specific to the topic, text, or issue under discussion.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can ask questions that deepen a discussion and respond with detailed comments that move it forward.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can pose and respond to specific questions with elaboration and detail that add to the discussion.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can ask or answer a question about the topic using question stems.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can answer a yes or no question about the topic with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can ask and answer questions about the topic under discussion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. d. Review the key ideas expressed and demonstrate an understanding of multiple perspectives through reflection and paraphrasing.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. d. Restate key ideas expressed in the discussion

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can summarize the key ideas of a discussion and explain how different perspectives changed my thinking.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can review key ideas and show I understand multiple perspectives by reflecting and paraphrasing.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can repeat one key idea from the discussion using a sentence frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to or say a word that shows what the group talked about with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can restate key ideas from a discussion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Interpret information presented in diverse media and formats and explain how it contributes to a topic, text, or issue under study.
ee_text: Identify information presented in diverse media and formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively, orally) that relates to a topic, text, or issue under study.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how information from different media adds to my understanding and judge which source is most useful.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can interpret information from different media and formats and explain how it adds to a topic, text or issue.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell one thing I learned from a chart, video or talk using a frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to a picture or chart that shows the topic with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify information in different media and formats that relates to a topic.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Understand and evaluate a speaker’s argument and specific claims, distinguishing claims that are supported by reasons and evidence from claims that are not.
ee_text: Identify the reasons and evidence supporting the claims made by the speaker.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate how convincing a speaker's argument is and explain which claims lack enough evidence.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can understand and evaluate a speaker's argument and tell which claims are supported by reasons and evidence and which are not.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name the speaker's claim and one reason using a graphic organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what the speaker wants me to think with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify the reasons and evidence a speaker uses to support claims.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Presentation of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Present claims and findings in a logical order using relevant evidence and details to highlight main ideas or themes. Communicate clearly and in an engaging manner, considering the audience, purpose, and situation. Explain purpose of language choices.
ee_text: Clearly present findings on a topic including descriptions, facts, or details, considering the audience.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can present findings in a logical, engaging way, adjust for my audience and explain my language choices.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can present claims and findings in a logical order with evidence and details, speaking clearly for my audience and purpose.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can present a short report using notes or cue cards with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can share one fact about a topic with an adult or partner using a picture.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can clearly present findings on a topic with descriptions, facts or details for my audience.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Presentation of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Include multimedia components and visual displays in presentations to clarify and enhance information.
ee_text: Select an auditory, visual, or tactual display to clarify the information in presentations.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can design multimedia and visual displays that make complex information clear and memorable.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can include multimedia and visual displays in presentations to clarify and enhance information.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can add a picture or chart to my presentation from a choice of options.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can choose a picture that matches my topic with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can select an audio, visual or tactile display to clarify information in my presentation.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. a. Recognize that standardized English is only one dialect of many and has a specific history that is implicated in power relationships.
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. a. Notice that standardized English is only one dialect of many and has a specific history.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can explain how the history of standardized English connects to power and compare it with other dialects I know.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can recognize that standardized English is one dialect of many and that its history is connected to power.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name one difference between how people speak at home and at school with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can notice that people speak in different ways in different places with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can notice that standardized English is one dialect of many with its own history.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. b. Determine the language demands of a writing or speaking situation, respond in appropriate ways (e.g., precise and concise language, extended and descriptive language, incorporation of code-meshing, etc.).
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. b. Notice the language demands of a writing/speaking situation (i.e. formal, informal) and respond in an appropriate way.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze the language demands of different situations and shift my language, including code-meshing, on purpose.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can determine the language demands of a writing or speaking situation and respond in appropriate ways.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell if a situation is formal or informal and choose matching words with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can sort phrases into school talk and friend talk with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can notice whether a situation is formal or informal and respond in an appropriate way.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. c. Expand, combine, and reduce sentences for meaning, reader or listener interest, and style.
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. c. Expand or combine sentences for meaning, interest, and style.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can expand, combine and cut sentences on purpose to control rhythm, interest and style.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can expand, combine and reduce sentences for meaning, reader interest and style.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can combine two short sentences using and, but or because with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can add one word to make a sentence longer with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can expand or combine sentences for meaning, interest and style.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. d. Maintain consistency in style and tone.
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. d. Maintain consistency in use of language.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can keep a consistent style and tone across a long piece and explain why it fits my purpose.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can maintain a consistent style and tone in my writing and speaking.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can check a short piece for one change in tone using a checklist with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell whether a sentence sounds friendly or serious with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can keep my use of language consistent.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases in grade-level reading and content; use context clues, analyze meaningful word parts, consult general and specialized reference materials, and apply word solving strategies (for meaning) as appropriate. a. Verify the preliminary determination of the meaning of a word or phrase (e.g., by checking the inferred meaning in context or in a dictionary).
ee_text: Demonstrate knowledge of word meanings. a. Use context to determine which word is missing from a content area text.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can check the meaning of a new word in several ways and explain which strategy helped most.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can verify my first guess about a word's meaning by checking context or a dictionary.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can guess a word's meaning from context and check it in a dictionary with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find a new word in a picture dictionary with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use context to work out which word is missing from a text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases in grade-level reading and content; use context clues, analyze meaningful word parts, consult general and specialized reference materials, and apply word solving strategies (for meaning) as appropriate. b. Use grade-appropriate Greek or Latin affixes and roots as clues to the meaning of a word.
ee_text: Demonstrate knowledge of word meanings. b. Use frequently occurring root words (e.g., like) and the words that result when affixes are added (e.g., liked, disliked, liking). c. Seek clarification and meaning support when unfamiliar words are encountered while reading or communicating.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use Greek and Latin roots and affixes to work out the meanings of unfamiliar academic words.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use grade-appropriate Greek or Latin affixes and roots as clues to a word's meaning.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find a known root or affix in a word and use a chart to guess its meaning.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find a small word I know inside a bigger word with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use root words and affixes to understand words and ask for help with unfamiliar words.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings. a. Determine the denotative, connotative, and figurative meanings of words and phrases used in texts; when words have similar denotations, be able to describe differences in connotation and their impact on meaning and tone.
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of word relationships and use. a. Determine the meaning of words in a text, distinguish between literal and non-literal language.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can explain how connotation shapes tone and choose words with the exact shade of meaning I need.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can determine denotative, connotative and figurative meanings of words and explain how differences in connotation affect meaning and tone.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell if a word has a positive or negative feeling using examples.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell whether a phrase means exactly what it says with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can determine word meanings in a text and tell literal from non-literal language.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings. b. Interpret figures of speech (e.g., personification) in context.
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of word relationships and use. b. Identify the meaning of simple similes (e.g., The man was as big as a tree.).

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can interpret different figures of speech and explain how they add meaning to a text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can interpret figures of speech, such as personification, in context.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can explain what a simple personification or simile means with a picture or example.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can match a simile to its meaning with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify the meaning of simple similes.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings. c. Use the relationship between particular words (e.g., cause and effect) to better understand each of the words.
ee_text: Not applicable

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can explain how word relationships, such as cause and effect or part and whole, deepen meaning in complex texts.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use the relationship between words, such as cause and effect, to understand each word better.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can sort word pairs by relationship (cause and effect) using a chart with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can match a cause picture to an effect picture with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings. d. Distinguish between words with similar definitions (e.g., stingy, scrimping, economical, unwasteful, thrifty).
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of word relationships and use. d. Demonstrate understanding of words by identifying other words with similar and different meanings

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose the most precise word from a group of synonyms and explain the difference in meaning.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can distinguish between words with similar definitions, such as stingy, economical and thrifty.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can put similar words in order from weakest to strongest with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can match a word to a word that means almost the same with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify words with similar and different meanings.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Demonstrate an ability to collaboratively and independently build vocabulary knowledge when encountering unknown words including cultural, general academic, and discipline-specific terms and phrases; make intentional vocabulary choices appropriate to the context and situation.
ee_text: Use general academic and domain-specific words and phrases across contexts.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can independently build my vocabulary and choose words that fit different cultural, academic and subject contexts.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can build vocabulary with others and on my own, including cultural, academic and subject words, and choose words that fit the situation.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use new academic words from a word wall in my speaking and writing with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use a few key subject words with pictures and help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use general academic and subject-specific words across contexts.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English grammar and usage when writing or speaking. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose of language choice with: a. use of objective, subjective, possessive, and intensive pronouns; and
ee_text: Demonstrate standardized English grammar and usage when communicating. a. Use personal pronouns (e.g., he, she, they) per the preference of the subject.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use objective, subjective, possessive and intensive pronouns correctly and explain why each fits.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use objective, subjective, possessive and intensive pronouns correctly in writing and speaking and explain my choices.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can choose the correct pronoun (he, him, his) to complete a sentence with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use I, me and my correctly with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use personal pronouns that match the person I am talking about.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English grammar and usage when writing or speaking. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose of language choice with: b. strategies to improve expression in conventional language.
ee_text: Demonstrate standardized English grammar and usage when communicating. b. Use indefinite pronouns.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use several strategies to improve how I express ideas and explain how they help my reader.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use strategies to improve expression in conventional language.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can fix one sentence using a model with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can say a complete sentence with an adult model.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use indefinite pronouns such as someone and everything.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose in conventions with: a. commas, parentheses, and dashes, and
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of conventions of standardized English. a. Use question marks at the end of written questions.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use commas, parentheses and dashes to add information and explain how each changes the effect.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use commas, parentheses and dashes correctly in my writing and explain their purpose.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can add commas to a list or after an introductory word with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find the commas in a sentence with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use question marks at the end of written questions.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose in conventions with: b. correct spelling.
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of conventions of standardized English. b. Spell untaught words phonetically, drawing on letter-sound relationships and common spelling patterns.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can spell grade-level words correctly and use spelling patterns and resources to spell complex words.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can spell correctly in my writing.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can spell common words correctly and use a word wall or spell-checker for others.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can spell my name and a few familiar words with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can spell new words by sounding them out and using common spelling patterns.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: Cite textual evidence to support an analysis of what the text says explicitly or implicitly and make logical inferences. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Analyze text to identify where information is explicitly stated and where inferences must be drawn. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can cite the strongest evidence for my inferences and explain why some evidence is stronger than other evidence.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can cite several pieces of text evidence to support my analysis of what the text says directly and the inferences I make.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find one or two sentences that support my answer using a sentence starter.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find a word or sentence in the text that answers a simple question with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify where information is stated directly in a text and where I must make an inference.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: Summarize texts, from a variety of genres, to determine a theme or central idea and analyze its development over the course of the text. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Determine details in a text that are related to the theme or main idea and how it is developed over the course of a text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write an objective summary and analyze how two or more central ideas or themes develop and interact across a text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can summarize a text and analyze how its theme or central idea develops over the course of the text.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name the central idea and list key details in order using a graphic organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what a short text is mostly about using a picture or word bank with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can find details related to the theme or main idea and tell how it develops across the text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: In literary texts, analyze how elements of plot are related, affect one another, and contribute to meaning. (RL) In informational texts, analyze how individuals, events, and ideas are introduced, related to each other, and developed. (RI)
ee_text: In literary texts determine how two or more story elements are related. (RL) In informational texts, identify how two individuals, events, or ideas are related. (RI)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how plot elements or people, events and ideas influence one another to shape the meaning of a text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can analyze how plot elements affect each other and contribute to meaning, and how people, events and ideas are introduced and developed in informational texts.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can explain how one event causes another in a story or text using a cause and effect chart.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can name the setting, a character and an event with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell how two story elements, or two people, events or ideas, are related.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: Determine the meaning of words and phrases, including figurative and connotative meanings. Analyze the impact of specific word choices on meaning, tone, and mood, including words with multiple meanings within a text. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Determine how word choice changes the meaning in a text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how repeated word choices and figurative language build tone and mood across a whole text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can determine the meaning of words, including figurative and connotative meanings, and analyze how word choice affects meaning, tone and mood.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use context clues to define a word and tell whether it sounds positive or negative with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can match a new word with its meaning using a picture or word bank with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell how word choice changes the meaning in a text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: In literary texts, analyze how structure, including genre-specific features, contributes to the development of themes or central ideas. (RL) In informational texts, analyze the structure an author uses to organize a text, including how the sections contribute to the whole and to the development of themes or central ideas. (RI)
ee_text: Given guidance and support, compare the structure of two or more texts (e.g., stories, poems, dramas, argument, directions, informational) and determine how a fact, step, or event fits into the overall structure of the text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can compare how different genres or text structures develop the same theme or central idea.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can analyze how a text's structure, including genre features and sections, contributes to the development of themes or central ideas.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name the structure of a text (such as sequence or problem and solution) using a chart.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what comes first, next and last in a text with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, compare the structure of two texts and tell how a fact, step or event fits into the structure.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: In literary texts, analyze how an author develops and contrasts the point of view, possible biases, and the perspectives of different characters or narrators. (RL) In informational texts, explain how an author’s geographic location, identity, or culture affect perspective. Analyze how the author distinguishes his or her position from that of others. (RI)
ee_text: Identify words or phrases in the text that describe or show the narrator, speaker, or author’s point of view. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how authors contrast perspectives and biases and how a writer's culture or location shapes their position compared with others.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can analyze how an author develops and contrasts points of view, biases and perspectives, and explain how an author's background shapes perspective.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell the point of view of two characters or the author using clue words with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell who is telling a story with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can find words or phrases that show the narrator's, speaker's or author's point of view.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Compare and contrast a written text with audio, filmed, staged, or digital versions in order to analyze the effects of techniques unique to each media and each format’s portrayal of a subject. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Compare a text to an audio, video, or multimedia version of the same text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate how techniques in audio, film, stage or digital versions change the meaning of a text compared with the written version.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can compare a written text with audio, filmed, staged or digital versions and analyze the effects of each format's techniques.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can list what is the same and different between a text and its video version using a Venn diagram.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to a scene in a video that matches part of the text with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can compare a text with an audio, video or multimedia version of the same text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Trace and evaluate the development of an argument and specific claims in a text. Assess whether the reasoning is valid and the evidence is relevant and sufficient. Recognize when irrelevant evidence is introduced. (RI)
ee_text: Determine how a claim or reason fits into the overall structure of a text. (RI)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate an argument and explain how irrelevant or weak evidence affects its overall strength.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can trace and evaluate an argument, judging whether reasoning is valid and evidence is relevant and sufficient, and notice irrelevant evidence.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find the author's claim and two reasons and tell if each reason makes sense with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what the author wants me to believe with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell how a claim or reason fits into the structure of a text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Evaluate the quality of texts. Make connections to other texts, ideas, cultural perspectives, identities, eras, and personal experiences. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Compare and contrast how two texts describe details and make connections to other texts, ideas, cultural perspectives, identities, eras, or personal experiences. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can develop criteria to evaluate texts and analyze how texts from different cultures or eras treat the same topic.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can evaluate the quality of a text and make connections to other texts, ideas, cultural perspectives, identities, eras and my own experiences.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can give a reason a text is good or not and connect it to another text or my life using sentence starters.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell how a story is like my own life using pictures with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can compare and contrast how two texts describe details and make connections to other texts, ideas, cultures or my own experiences.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Compose reflective, formal, and creative writing, which may happen simultaneously or independently, for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use drawing, dictating, or writing to compose writing for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can blend reflective, formal and creative writing on purpose and explain how the blend serves my purpose.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write reflective, formal and creative pieces for both high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write a short piece for a given purpose using a model and sentence frames.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can draw, dictate or write a few words to share an idea with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, draw, dictate or write to share my ideas for different purposes.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Write text in a variety of modes. a. Write arguments to support claims with clear reasons, relevant evidence, and literary theory. Introduce claim(s), acknowledge alternate or opposing claims, and organize the reasons and evidence logically. Use accurate, credible sources.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing and/or dictation to write in a variety of modes: a. Write an argument with a clearly stated claim about a topic and include clear reasons to support that claim.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write an argument that answers opposing claims with strong evidence from credible sources.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write an argument that introduces a claim, acknowledges opposing claims and organizes reasons and evidence logically using credible sources.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write a claim with two reasons and one piece of evidence using an organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can say or write what I think about a topic and why with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate a clearly stated claim about a topic with clear reasons.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Write text in a variety of modes. b. Write informative text that examines a topic and conveys ideas, concepts, and information through the selection and organization of relevant content by introducing and developing a topic with relevant, well-chosen facts, definitions, concrete details, quotations, or other information and examples, organizing ideas, concepts, and information into broader categories; include formatting (e.g., headings), graphics (e.g., charts, tables), and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing and/or dictation to write in a variety of modes: b. Write informative texts which introduce a topic and provide facts, details, and/or multimedia content to develop the topic. Provide a concluding statement.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write an informative text that synthesizes well-chosen information from several sources and uses formatting and visuals to aid understanding.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write an informative text that develops a topic with relevant facts, definitions, details and quotations, organized into categories with useful formatting and graphics.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write an informative paragraph with a topic sentence, facts and a conclusion using a frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can share facts about a topic using words, pictures or dictation with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate an informative text that introduces a topic, gives facts and details and has a conclusion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Write text in a variety of modes. c. Write narratives that develop real or imagined experiences or events using relevant descriptive details and well-structured event sequences that organize an event sequence logically. Engage and orient the reader by establishing a context and point of view and introduce a narrator or characters using techniques, such as dialogue, pacing, description, and reflection, to develop experiences, events, and characters.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing and/or dictation to write in a variety of modes: c. Write narratives to convey events and experiences, real or imagined. Include dialogue, details, and tell about the events in the order in which they occurred.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write a narrative that uses dialogue, pacing and reflection to develop characters and build tension.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write a narrative that establishes a context and point of view, introduces characters and uses dialogue, pacing, description and a logical event sequence.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write a short story with characters, a problem and a solution using a story map.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell or draw what happened first, next and last with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate a narrative with dialogue and details that tells events in order.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Create writing that utilizes: a. Organization: Provide an introduction that creates suspense and anticipation for the reader. Structure of the text supports and clarifies the purpose and topic. Provide a concluding statement appropriate to the mode of writing.
ee_text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating and writing to create a text that includes an introduction, body, and conclusion, uses words that convey specific details, transitions to link and build connections, and temporal words to signal event order.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can hook readers with suspense, structure my text to build purpose, and end with a conclusion that adds meaning.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write an introduction that creates suspense, structure my text to support the purpose and write a fitting conclusion.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write an introduction, body and conclusion using a planning frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can put my ideas in order (first, then, last) with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, create a text with an introduction, body and conclusion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Create writing that utilizes: b. Transitions: Use a variety of appropriate transitions that connect and develop ideas.
ee_text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating and writing to create a text that includes an introduction, body, and conclusion, uses words that convey specific details, transitions to link and build connections, and temporal words to signal event order.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose precise transitions that show subtle relationships between ideas across a whole text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use a variety of appropriate transitions to connect and develop ideas.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use transitions such as for example, however and as a result from a word bank.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use simple linking words such as and, then or because with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use transitions and time-order words to link my ideas.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Create writing that utilizes: c. Word Choice (including domain specific): Use words, phrases, and clauses to create cohesion and clarify the relationships. Use sensory language to describe experiences and events.
ee_text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating and writing to create a text that includes an introduction, body, and conclusion, uses words that convey specific details, transitions to link and build connections, and temporal words to signal event order.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose words, phrases and clauses that create strong cohesion and vivid sensory detail.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use words, phrases and clauses to create cohesion and clarify relationships, and use sensory language to describe experiences.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can add sensory words and linking phrases from a word bank with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use simple describing words to tell about a picture or event.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use words that give specific details.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: Independently and collaboratively produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are culturally-sustaining and rhetorically authentic to task, purpose, and audience. (Grade-specific expectations for writing types are defined in standards 1-3 above.)
ee_text: Independently and collaboratively produce writing that is appropriate for the task, purpose, or audience.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can adapt the development, organization and style of my writing for different audiences and explain why.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can independently and with others produce clear writing whose development, organization and style fit the task, purpose and audience.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can produce writing that fits a task when I use a model or checklist.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can write or dictate a few sentences on a topic with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, on my own and with others, produce writing that fits the task, purpose or audience.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults and peers, plan before writing and produce writing focused on the planned topic, and revise and edit their own writing, dictation, or pictures.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can revise independently, trying new approaches, and explain how my changes better serve my purpose and audience.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can, with some help, plan, revise, edit and rewrite my writing, focusing on how well it meets my purpose and audience.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can revise one part of my writing for my audience using a checklist and feedback.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can add a word or fix a capital letter when an adult points to it.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, plan my writing and revise and edit it.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: Use technology, (including paper and pencil, internet, audio, visual, multilingual, multimodal, mobile, or other interactive formats), to produce and publish writing and present the relationships between information and ideas efficiently, as well as to interact and collaborate with others, including linking to and citing sources.
ee_text: Use technology, (including paper and pencil, internet, audio, visual, and/or other interactive formats) to produce writing to interact and collaborate with others. Produce writing through printing, cursive, and/or typing.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose and use digital tools to publish, collaborate and link and cite sources efficiently for a real audience.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use technology to produce and publish writing, show relationships between ideas, collaborate with others and link to and cite sources.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can publish a short piece with a template and add one link to a source with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use a device to type or record a few words with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use technology to produce writing and work with others, using printing, cursive or typing.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Conduct short inquiry projects to answer a question, drawing on several sources and generating additional related, focused questions for further research and investigation.
ee_text: With guidance and support, conduct short inquiry projects to answer a question.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can conduct inquiry projects that lead me to new, focused research questions and explain how they extend my learning.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can conduct short inquiry projects using several sources and generate related, focused questions for further research.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can answer a research question using two given sources and write one new question with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find one fact about a topic in a book or website with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, conduct a short inquiry project to answer a question.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources using search terms effectively, assess the credibility and accuracy of each source, quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and following a standard format for citation.
ee_text: Identify quotes providing relevant information about a topic from multiple print or digital sources.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use effective search terms, judge source accuracy and integrate quotes and paraphrases with correct citations.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can gather information using effective search terms, assess credibility and accuracy, quote or paraphrase without plagiarizing and cite sources in a standard format.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find two sources, take notes in my own words and write a simple citation using a template.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can copy a fact and where it came from with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify quotes that give relevant information about a topic from print or digital sources.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis, reflection, and inquiry. (Apply grade 7 Reading standards)
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support reflection or inquiry questions based on a reading of a literary or informational text.
