descriptors.cc_advanced: I can select and explain the most convincing evidence from texts to support a detailed analysis.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis, reflection and inquiry.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find a quote that supports my answer using a sentence starter.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to a picture or sentence that matches my idea with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use evidence from a text to support my reflection or answer an inquiry question.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. a. Come to discussions prepared and explicitly draw on that preparation by referring to evidence on the topic, text, or issue. Support analysis by making connections, paraphrasing, clarifying, or explaining the evidence.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. a. Come to discussions prepared to share information, with evidence.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can come prepared with evidence and use it to analyze, challenge or extend my peers' ideas.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can come to discussions prepared and refer to evidence, making connections, paraphrasing or explaining to support analysis.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can bring notes and share one piece of evidence using a sentence frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can share a picture or fact I prepared when asked with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can come to discussions prepared to share information and evidence.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. b. With guidance and support, set and track specific norms and goals for collegial discussions (e.g., gaining attention in respectful ways, actively listening, speaking one at a time about the topics and texts under discussion).
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. b. With guidance and support from adults and peers, follow simple, agreed-upon norms for discussions and contribute information.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can help my group set, track and reflect on discussion norms and goals.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can, with guidance, set and track specific norms and goals for discussions.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can follow discussion norms and check one goal on a group checklist.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can listen and wait for my turn with adult support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, follow simple discussion norms and contribute information.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. c. Pose questions that invite elaboration and respond to others' questions and comments with relevant observations and ideas that bring the discussion back on topic as needed. Promote multiple perspectives.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. c. Remain on the topic of the discussion when answering questions or making other contributions to a discussion.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can ask questions that invite deeper thinking, bring the discussion back on topic and draw in different perspectives.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can pose questions that invite elaboration, respond with relevant ideas, bring the discussion back on topic and promote multiple perspectives.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can ask a follow-up question or add a related comment using question stems.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can answer a question about the topic with a word or picture with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can stay on topic when I answer questions or add to a discussion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. d. Review the key ideas expressed and demonstrate an understanding of multiple perspectives through analysis, including reflection, clarification, and paraphrasing.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. d. Acknowledge new information and multiple perspectives expressed by others in a discussion.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how different perspectives in a discussion connect and explain how they shaped my thinking.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can review key ideas and show I understand multiple perspectives through reflection, clarification and paraphrasing.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can paraphrase one classmate's idea using a sentence frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to or say a word that shows what the group talked about with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can acknowledge new information and different perspectives shared by others.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Analyze the main ideas and supporting details presented in diverse media and formats and explain how the ideas clarify a topic, text, or issue under study.
ee_text: Identify details related to the main idea of a text presented orally or through other media.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how ideas from several media sources work together or conflict to clarify an issue.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can analyze the main ideas and details in different media and formats and explain how they clarify a topic, text or issue.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name the main idea and one detail from a video or talk using a frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to a picture or chart that shows the main idea with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify details related to the main idea of a text presented orally or through other media.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Understand and evaluate a speaker’s argument and specific claims, evaluating the soundness of the reasoning and the relevance and sufficiency of the evidence.
ee_text: Determine whether the claims made by a speaker are fact or opinion.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate a speaker's argument and explain how unsound reasoning or weak evidence affects it.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can evaluate a speaker's argument, judging the soundness of the reasoning and the relevance and sufficiency of the evidence.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name the speaker's claim and tell if one reason is supported using a graphic organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what the speaker wants me to think with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell whether a speaker's claims are fact or opinion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Presentation of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Present claims and findings, emphasizing significant points in a focused, coherent manner using relevant evidence. Communicate clearly and in an engaging manner, considering the audience, purpose, and situation. Explain purpose of language choices.
ee_text: Clearly present findings on a topic including relevant descriptions, facts, or details, considering the audience.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can deliver a focused, engaging presentation that emphasizes key points and explain my language choices for my audience.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can present claims and findings in a focused, coherent way with relevant evidence, speaking clearly and explaining my language choices.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can present a short report using notes and a model with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can share one fact about a topic with a partner using a picture.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can clearly present findings on a topic with relevant descriptions, facts or details for my audience.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Presentation of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Include multimedia components and visual displays in presentations to clarify claims and findings and emphasize significant points.
ee_text: Select or create audio recordings and visual/tactile displays to emphasize specific points in a presentation.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can design multimedia that strengthens my claims and makes my most important points stand out.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can include multimedia and visual displays to clarify claims and findings and emphasize significant points.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can add a picture, chart or sound to my presentation from given options.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can choose a picture that matches my topic with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can select or create audio, visual or tactile displays to emphasize points in a presentation.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. a. Recognize that standardized English is only one dialect of many and has a specific history that is implicated in power relationships.
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. a. Notice that standardized English is only one dialect of many and has a specific history that is implicated in power relationships.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can explain how the history of standardized English is connected to power and how that affects speakers of other dialects.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can recognize that standardized English is one dialect of many and that its history is connected to power.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name one difference between home language and school language with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can notice that people speak in different ways in different places with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can notice that standardized English is one dialect of many with a history connected to power.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. b. Determine the language demands of a writing or speaking situation; respond in appropriate ways (e.g., precise and concise language, extended and descriptive language, incorporation of code-meshing, etc.).
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. b. Notice the language demands of a writing/speaking situation (i.e. formal, informal) and respond in an appropriate way.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze a situation's language demands and shift my language, including code-meshing, for effect.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can determine the language demands of a writing or speaking situation and respond in appropriate ways.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell if a situation is formal or informal and choose matching words with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can sort phrases into school talk and friend talk with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can notice whether a situation is formal or informal and respond in an appropriate way.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. c. Maintain consistency in style and tone.
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. c. Maintain consistency in use of language.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can keep a consistent style and tone across different pieces and explain how it suits each audience.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can maintain a consistent style and tone in my writing and speaking.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can check one piece for a change in tone using a checklist with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell whether a sentence sounds friendly or serious with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can keep my use of language consistent.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. d. When appropriate, eliminate wordiness and redundancy.
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. d. Notice redundancy in language.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can edit my own writing to cut wordiness and redundancy and explain how it improves clarity.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can eliminate wordiness and redundancy when appropriate.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find and cross out a repeated word or idea in a sentence with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can notice when the same word is used twice with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can notice redundancy in language.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases in grade-level reading and content; use context clues, analyze meaningful word parts, consult general and specialized reference materials, and apply word solving strategies (for meaning) as appropriate. a. Verify the preliminary determination of the meaning of a word or phrase (e.g., by checking the inferred meaning in context or in a dictionary).
ee_text: Demonstrate knowledge of word meanings. a. Use context to determine which word is missing from a text.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can check a word's meaning with several strategies and explain which one was most reliable.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can verify my first guess about a word's meaning by checking context or a dictionary.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can guess a word's meaning from context and check it in a dictionary with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find a new word in a picture dictionary with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use context to work out which word is missing from a text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases in grade-level reading and content; use context clues, analyze meaningful word parts, consult general and specialized reference materials, and apply word solving strategies (for meaning) as appropriate. b. Use grade-appropriate Greek or Latin affixes and roots as clues to the meaning of a word.
ee_text: Demonstrate knowledge of word meanings. b. Use frequently occurring root words (e.g., like) and the words that result when affixes are added (e.g., liked, disliked, liking). c. Seek clarification and meaning support when unfamiliar words are encountered while reading or communicating.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use Greek and Latin roots and affixes to work out and explain the meanings of complex academic words.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use grade-appropriate Greek or Latin affixes and roots as clues to a word's meaning.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find a known root or affix in a word and use a chart to guess its meaning.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find a small word I know inside a bigger word with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use root words and affixes to understand words and ask for help with unfamiliar words.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings. Determine the denotative, connotative, and figurative meanings of words and phrases used in texts; when words have similar denotations, be able to describe differences in connotation and their impact on meaning and tone. Analyze the impact of rhyme and other repetitions of sound (e.g., alliteration, assonance) in varied texts (e.g., poetry, drama, section of a story).
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of word relationships and use. a. Identify the literal and nonliteral meanings of words in context. b. Identify rhyme and repetition (letters, words, or phrases)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can explain how connotation, rhyme and repeated sounds work together to create meaning and tone.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can determine denotative, connotative and figurative meanings, describe connotation differences, and analyze the impact of rhyme and repeated sounds in texts.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find rhyme or alliteration in a poem and tell whether a word feels positive or negative with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can clap or point to rhyming words with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify literal and nonliteral meanings of words and identify rhyme and repetition.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Demonstrate an ability to collaboratively and independently build vocabulary knowledge when encountering unknown words including cultural, general academic, and discipline-specific terms and phrases; make intentional vocabulary choices appropriate to the context and situation.
ee_text: Use general academic and domain-specific words and phrases across contexts.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can independently build vocabulary and make intentional word choices for cultural, academic and subject contexts.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can build vocabulary with others and on my own, including cultural, academic and subject terms, and choose words that fit the situation.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use new academic words from a word wall in my speaking and writing with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use a few key subject words with pictures and help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use general academic and subject-specific words across contexts.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English grammar and usage when writing or speaking. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose of language choice with: a. phrases and clauses;
ee_text: Demonstrate standardized English grammar and usage when communicating. a. Use simple phrases.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use phrases and clauses on purpose to add detail and variety and explain their effect.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use phrases and clauses correctly and explain their purpose in my writing and speaking.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can add a phrase to a sentence using a model with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can say a simple phrase about a picture with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use simple phrases.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English grammar and usage when writing or speaking. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose of language choice with: b. simple, compound, and complex sentences signaling differing relationships among ideas; and
ee_text: Demonstrate standardized English grammar and usage when communicating. b. Produce complete simple sentences when writing or communicating.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose simple, compound or complex sentences to show exact relationships between ideas and explain my choice.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use simple, compound and complex sentences to show different relationships among ideas.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can join two sentences with and, but or because using a frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can say a complete simple sentence with an adult model.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can produce complete simple sentences when writing or communicating.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English grammar and usage when writing or speaking. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose of language choice with: c. recognizing and correcting dangling modifiers.
ee_text: Not applicable

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can find and fix dangling modifiers in my own and others' writing and explain the confusion they cause.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can recognize and correct dangling modifiers.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can fix a dangling modifier in a given sentence using a model.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell which picture matches a sentence with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose in conventions with: a. commas to separate coordinate adjectives and
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of conventions of standardized English. a. Use end punctuation when writing a sentence or question.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use commas between coordinate adjectives correctly and explain how they affect meaning.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use commas to separate coordinate adjectives and explain their purpose.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can add a comma between two describing words using examples.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find the commas in a sentence with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use end punctuation when writing a sentence or question.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose in conventions with: b. correct spelling.
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of conventions of standardized English. b. Spell words phonetically, drawing on knowledge of letter-sound relationships and/or common spelling patterns.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can spell grade-level and complex words correctly and use patterns and resources to check my spelling.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can spell correctly in my writing.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can spell common words correctly and use a word wall or spell-checker for others.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can spell my name and a few familiar words with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can spell words by using letter-sound relationships and common spelling patterns.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: Cite textual evidence that strongly supports an analysis of what the text says explicitly or implicitly and make logical inferences. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Cite text to support inferences from text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose the strongest evidence for a complex inference and explain why it is more convincing than other evidence.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can cite text evidence that strongly supports my analysis of what the text says directly and the inferences I make.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find a sentence that supports my inference using a sentence starter.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find a word or sentence that answers a simple question with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can cite text to support an inference I make from a text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: Summarize texts, from a variety of genres, to determine one or more themes or central ideas and analyze their development over the course of the text. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Summarize a familiar text and determine details related to the theme or main idea. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write an objective summary and analyze how several themes or central ideas develop and connect across a text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can summarize a text and analyze how one or more themes or central ideas develop over the course of the text.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name a central idea and list key details in order using a graphic organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what a familiar text is mostly about using a picture or word bank with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can summarize a familiar text and find details related to its theme or main idea.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: In literary texts, analyze how particular lines of dialogue or events propel the action, reveal aspects of a character, or provoke a decision. (RL) In informational texts, analyze how individuals, events, and ideas are introduced, related to each other, and developed. (RI)
ee_text: In literary texts, identify which incidents in a text lead to subsequent action. (RL) In informational texts, identify how two or more individuals, events, or ideas are related. (RI)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how specific dialogue or events change the direction of a story or how ideas build on each other in a complex text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can analyze how dialogue or events propel action, reveal character or provoke decisions, and how people, events and ideas are introduced and developed.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can explain how one event or line of dialogue leads to what happens next using a chart.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can name a character and an important event with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell which events lead to later action, or how two or more people, events or ideas are related.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: Determine the meaning of words and phrases, including figurative and connotative meanings. Analyze the impact of specific word choices on meaning, tone, and mood, including words with multiple meanings within a text. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Determine the connotative meanings of words and phrases in a text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how word choices, including multiple meanings and figurative language, work together to create tone and mood across a text.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can determine the meaning of words, including figurative and connotative meanings, and analyze how word choice affects meaning, tone and mood.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use context clues to define a word and tell its positive or negative feeling with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can match a new word with its meaning using a picture or word bank with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell the connotative meanings of words and phrases in a text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: In literary and informational texts, compare and contrast the structures of two or more texts in order to analyze how the differing structure of each text contributes to overall meaning, style, theme, or central idea. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Compare and contrast the structure of two or more texts (RL and RI) and use important details to identify the main idea in an informational text.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate which of two text structures is more effective for conveying a theme or central idea and explain why.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can compare and contrast the structures of two or more texts and analyze how each structure contributes to meaning, style, theme or central idea.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name the structure of two texts and list one difference using a Venn diagram.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell whether a text is a story or gives information with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can compare the structure of two texts and use important details to find the main idea of an informational text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Craft & Structure
text: In literary texts, analyze how the differences between the point of view, perspectives, and possible biases of the characters, the audience, or reader create effects such as mood and tone. (RL) In informational texts, explain how an author’s geographic location, identity, or culture affect perspective. Analyze how the author addresses conflicting evidence or viewpoints. (RI)
ee_text: Determine the narrator, speaker, or author’s point of view and how it differs from the audience or reader. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how differences in point of view create effects such as suspense or humor and how authors handle conflicting viewpoints.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can analyze how differences in point of view and bias create mood and tone, and how an author's background and handling of conflicting evidence shape perspective.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can compare what a character knows with what the reader knows using a chart.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell who is telling the story with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can tell the narrator's, speaker's or author's point of view and how it differs from mine as the reader.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of using different media, print, audio, video, stage, or digital, to present a particular subject or idea and analyze the extent to which a production remains faithful to or departs from the written text. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Compare and contrast a text version of a story, drama, or poem with an audio, video, or live version of the same text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate how a production's choices to stay faithful to or change a text affect its meaning and audience.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of different media for presenting an idea and analyze how far a production stays faithful to the written text.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can list what is the same and different between a text and a film or play version using a Venn diagram.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to a scene in a video that matches the text with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can compare and contrast a written story, drama or poem with an audio, video or live version.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Trace and evaluate an argument and specific claims in a text. Assess whether the reasoning is valid and the evidence is relevant and sufficient. Recognize when irrelevant evidence is introduced. (RI)
ee_text: Determine the argument made by an author in a text. (RI)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate an argument, explain how irrelevant evidence weakens it and suggest stronger evidence.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can trace and evaluate an argument, judging whether reasoning is valid and evidence is relevant and sufficient, and recognize irrelevant evidence.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find the claim and reasons and tell whether one reason is relevant using a graphic organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what the author wants me to believe with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can determine the argument an author makes in a text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Integration of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Choose and develop criteria to evaluate the quality of texts. Make connections to other texts, ideas, cultural perspectives, identities, eras, and personal experiences. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Compare and contrast themes, patterns of events, or characters across two or more texts and make connections to other texts, ideas, cultural perspectives, identities, eras, or personal experiences. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can create and justify my own criteria for judging texts and apply them across texts from different cultures and eras.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can choose and develop criteria to evaluate the quality of texts and make connections to other texts, ideas, cultures, identities, eras and my own experiences.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use a given checklist to judge a text and make one connection to another text or my life.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell how a story is like my life using pictures with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can compare and contrast themes, events or characters across two texts and make connections to other texts, ideas, cultures or my own experiences.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Compose reflective, formal, and creative writing, which may happen simultaneously or independently, for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use drawing, dictating, or writing to compose writing for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can move between reflective, formal and creative writing on purpose and explain how each choice serves my audience.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write reflective, formal and creative pieces for both high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write a short piece for a given purpose using a model and sentence frames.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can draw, dictate or write a few words to share an idea with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, draw, dictate or write to share my ideas for different purposes.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Write text in a variety of modes. a. Write arguments to introduce and support claim(s) using logical reasoning, relevant evidence, and literary theory. Use accurate, credible sources and demonstrate an understanding of the topic or text, acknowledge and distinguish the claim(s) from alternate or opposing claims, and organize the reasons and evidence logically.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing and/or dictation to write in a variety of modes: a. Write an argument with a clearly stated claim about a topic and include clear reasons to support that claim. Organize reasons logically.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write an argument that distinguishes my claim from opposing claims and rebuts them with logical reasoning and credible evidence.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write an argument that introduces and supports claims with logical reasoning and credible evidence, distinguishes opposing claims and organizes reasons logically.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write a claim with reasons and evidence in a logical order using an organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can say or write what I think about a topic and why with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate a clear claim with reasons organized logically.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Write text in a variety of modes. b. Write informative or explanatory text, examine a topic and convey ideas, concepts, and information through the selection, organization, and analysis of relevant content by introducing and developing a topic with relevant, well-chosen facts, definitions, concrete details, quotations, or other information and examples, organizing ideas, concepts, and information into broader categories; include formatting (e.g., headings), graphics (e.g., charts, tables), and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing and/or dictation to write in a variety of modes: b. Write informative texts which introduce a topic and provide well chosen facts, details, and/or multimedia content to develop the topic. Provide a concluding statement.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write an informative text that analyzes a complex topic, synthesizing well-chosen evidence with formatting and multimedia.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write an informative text that develops a topic with well-chosen facts, definitions, details and quotations, organized into categories with useful formatting and graphics.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write an informative paragraph with facts, a definition and a conclusion using a frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can share facts about a topic using words, pictures or dictation with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate an informative text that introduces a topic, gives well-chosen facts and details and has a conclusion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Write text in a variety of modes. c. Write narratives that develop real or imagined experiences or events using relevant descriptive details, and well-structured event sequences that organize an event sequence logically. Engage and orient the reader by establishing a context and point of view and introduce a narrator or characters using techniques, such as dialogue, pacing, description, and reflection, to develop experiences, events, and characters.
ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing and/or dictation to write in a variety of modes: c. Write narratives to convey events and experiences, real or imagined. Include dialogue, details, character descriptions, and tell about the events in the order in which they occurred.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can write a narrative that uses pacing, reflection and multiple points of view to develop characters and theme.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write a narrative that establishes context and point of view, introduces characters and uses dialogue, pacing, description, reflection and a logical sequence.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write a short story with characters, dialogue and a clear sequence using a story map.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell or draw what happened first, next and last with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate a narrative with dialogue, details and character descriptions that tells events in order.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Create writing that utilizes: a. Organization: Provide an introduction that creates suspense and anticipation for the reader. Structure of the text supports and clarifies the purpose and topic throughout the entire text. Conclusion statement provides closure and ties up all loose ends.
ee_text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating and writing to create a text that includes an introduction, body, and conclusion, uses words that convey specific details, transitions to link and build connections, and temporal words to signal event order.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can structure a whole text so every part builds toward my purpose and end with a conclusion that resolves all threads.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can write an introduction that creates suspense, keep the structure supporting my purpose throughout and end with a conclusion that ties up loose ends.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can write an introduction, body and conclusion that stay on topic using a planning frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can put my ideas in order (first, then, last) with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, create a text with an introduction, body and conclusion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Create writing that utilizes: b. Transitions: Vary transitions to create cohesion and clarity among ideas and concepts.
ee_text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating and writing to create a text that includes an introduction, body, and conclusion, uses words that convey specific details, transitions to link and build connections, and temporal words to signal event order.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can vary transitions skillfully to create smooth, logical flow across complex ideas.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can vary transitions to create cohesion and clarity among ideas and concepts.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can choose different transitions from a word bank to connect my paragraphs.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use simple linking words such as and, then or because with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use transitions and time-order words to link my ideas.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Text Types & Purposes
text: Create writing that utilizes: c. Word Choice (including domain specific): Use genre-specific vocabulary. Use vocabulary that enhances the meaning and engages the reader.
ee_text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating and writing to create a text that includes an introduction, body, and conclusion, uses words that convey specific details, transitions to link and build connections, and temporal words to signal event order.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose genre-specific and vivid vocabulary that deepens meaning and holds the reader's interest.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use genre-specific vocabulary and words that enhance meaning and engage the reader.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can replace plain words with genre words from a word bank with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use simple describing words to tell about a picture or event.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use words that give specific details.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: Independently and collaboratively produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are culturally-sustaining and rhetorically authentic to task, purpose, and audience. (Grade-specific expectations for writing types are defined in standards 1-3 above.)
ee_text: Independently and collaboratively produce writing that is appropriate for the task, purpose, or audience.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can adapt my writing's development, organization and style for different audiences and explain each choice.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can independently and with others produce clear writing whose development, organization and style fit the task, purpose and audience.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can produce writing that fits a task when I use a model or checklist.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can write or dictate a few sentences on a topic with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, on my own and with others, produce writing that fits the task, purpose or audience.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults and peers, plan before writing and produce writing focused on the planned topic, and revise and edit their own writing, dictation, or pictures.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can revise independently by trying new approaches and explain how each change better meets my purpose and audience.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can, with some help, plan, revise, edit and rewrite, focusing on how well my writing meets my purpose and audience.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can revise one section for my audience using a checklist and peer feedback.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can add a word or fix a capital letter when an adult points to it.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, plan my writing and revise and edit it.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Production & Distribution of Writing
text: Use technology, (including paper and pencil, internet, audio, visual, multilingual, multimodal, mobile, or other interactive formats), to produce and publish writing and present the relationships between information and ideas efficiently as well as to interact and collaborate with others.
ee_text: Use technology,(including paper and pencil, internet, audio, visual, and/or other interactive formats) to produce writing to interact and collaborate with others. Produce writing through printing, cursive, and/or typing.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose the best digital tools to publish, show connections between ideas and collaborate efficiently with others.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use technology to produce and publish writing, present relationships between ideas efficiently and collaborate with others.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can publish a short piece using a template and comment on a peer's work with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use a device to type or record a few words with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use technology to produce writing and work with others, using printing, cursive or typing.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Conduct short inquiry projects to answer a question (including self-generated questions), drawing on several sources and generating additional related, focused questions that allow for multiple avenues of exploration.
ee_text: With guidance and support, conduct short inquiry projects to answer a question and generate additional questions for further research.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can design inquiry projects from my own questions and pursue several avenues of exploration from multiple sources.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can conduct short inquiry projects, including on my own questions, drawing on several sources and generating focused questions for further exploration.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can answer a research question using given sources and write two new questions with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find one fact about a topic in a book or website with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, conduct a short inquiry project and generate more questions for research.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources using search terms effectively, assess the credibility and accuracy of each source, quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and following a standard format for citation.
ee_text: Select quotes providing relevant information about a topic from multiple print or digital sources.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can search efficiently, evaluate source accuracy and integrate evidence smoothly with correct citations.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can gather information using effective search terms, assess credibility and accuracy, quote or paraphrase without plagiarizing and cite sources in a standard format.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find two sources, take notes in my own words and write citations using a template.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can copy a fact and where it came from with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can select quotes that give relevant information about a topic from print or digital sources.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Inquiry to Build & Present Knowledge
text: Draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis, reflection, and inquiry. (Apply grade 8 Reading standards)
ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support reflection or inquiry questions based on a reading of a literary or informational text.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can select and explain the most convincing evidence from texts to support a detailed analysis.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis, reflection and inquiry.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find a quote that supports my answer using a sentence starter.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to a picture or sentence that matches my idea with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use evidence from a text to support my reflection or answer an inquiry question.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. a. Come to discussions prepared, and explicitly draw on that preparation by referring to evidence on the topic, text, or issue. Support analysis by making connections, paraphrasing, clarifying, or explaining the evidence.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. a. Come to discussions prepared to share information previously studied, with evidence.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can come prepared with evidence and use it to analyze, challenge and build on my peers' ideas.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can come to discussions prepared and refer to evidence, making connections, paraphrasing or explaining to support analysis.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can bring notes and share evidence using a sentence frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can share a picture or fact I prepared when asked with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can come to discussions prepared to share information I studied, with evidence.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. b. Set and track specific norms and goals for collegial discussions (e.g., gaining attention in respectful ways, actively listening, speaking one at a time about the topics and texts under discussion), and monitor progress toward goals.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. b. Follow simple norms during discussions.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can lead my group in setting, tracking and reflecting on norms and goals.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can set and track specific norms and goals for discussions and monitor progress toward them.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can follow discussion norms and check our group goal on a checklist.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can listen and wait for my turn with adult support.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can follow simple norms during discussions.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. c. Pose questions that connect the ideas of several speakers and respond to others' questions and comments with relevant evidence, observations, and ideas. Promote multiple perspectives.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. c. Remain on the topic of the discussion when asking or answering questions or making other contributions to a discussion.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can ask questions that link several speakers' ideas and push the group toward deeper understanding of multiple perspectives.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can pose questions that connect several speakers' ideas, respond with relevant evidence and promote multiple perspectives.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can respond to a classmate's comment with my own idea using question stems.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can answer a question about the topic with a word or picture with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can stay on topic when I ask or answer questions or add to a discussion.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing one’s thinking clearly. d. Evaluate new information expressed by others and, when warranted, qualify or justify one’s own views in light of the evidence presented.
ee_text: Engage in collaborative discussions. d. Acknowledge new information and multiple perspectives expressed by others in a discussion and relate it to personal ideas.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can weigh new evidence from others and explain clearly how and why it changed or confirmed my view.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can evaluate new information from others and qualify or justify my own views based on the evidence.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can say whether I agree or disagree with a classmate and give one reason using a frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can show agree or disagree with a gesture or card with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can acknowledge new information and different perspectives and relate them to my own ideas.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Analyze the purpose of information presented in diverse media and formats and evaluate the motives (e.g., social, commercial, political) behind its presentation.
ee_text: Determine the purpose of information presented in graphic, oral, visual, or multimodal formats.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate the social, commercial or political motives behind media and explain how they shape the message.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can analyze the purpose of information in diverse media and formats and evaluate the motives behind its presentation.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell why an ad or video was made (to sell, inform or persuade) using a frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what an ad or video is about with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can determine the purpose of information presented in graphic, oral, visual or multimodal formats.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Comprehension & Collaboration
text: Understand and evaluate a speaker’s argument and specific claims, evaluating the soundness of the reasoning and relevance and sufficiency of the evidence and identifying when irrelevant evidence is introduced.
ee_text: Determine the argument made by a speaker on a topic.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can evaluate a speaker's argument and explain exactly where irrelevant evidence or weak reasoning appears.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can evaluate a speaker's argument, judging the soundness of the reasoning and evidence and identifying irrelevant evidence.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name the speaker's claim and tell whether one reason is relevant using a graphic organizer.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell what the speaker wants me to think with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can determine the argument a speaker makes on a topic.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Presentation of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Present claims and findings, emphasizing significant points in a focused, coherent manner with relevant evidence, sound valid reasoning, and well-chosen details. Communicate clearly and in an engaging manner, considering the audience, purpose, and situation. Explain purpose of language choices.
ee_text: Clearly present descriptions, facts, or details supporting specific points made on a topic, considering the audience.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can deliver a focused, engaging presentation with sound reasoning and explain my language choices for my audience.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can present claims and findings in a focused, coherent way with relevant evidence, valid reasoning and well-chosen details, explaining my language choices.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can present key points with evidence using notes and a model with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can share one fact about a topic with a partner using a picture.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can clearly present facts or details that support points on a topic for my audience.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Presentation of Knowledge & Ideas
text: Integrate multimedia and visual displays into presentations to clarify information, strengthen claims and evidence, and add interest.
ee_text: Include multimedia and visual information into presentations.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can integrate multimedia that strengthens my evidence and keeps my audience engaged.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can integrate multimedia and visual displays to clarify information, strengthen claims and evidence and add interest.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can add a chart, image or sound to my presentation from given options.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can choose a picture that matches my topic with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can include multimedia and visual information in presentations.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. a. Recognize that standardized English is only one dialect of many and has a specific history that is implicated in power relationships.
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. a. Notice that standardized English is only one dialect of many and has a specific history that is implicated in power relationships.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how the history of standardized English shapes power today and explain the value of other dialects.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can recognize that standardized English is one dialect of many and that its history is connected to power.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can name one difference between home language and school language with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can notice that people speak in different ways in different places with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can notice that standardized English is one dialect of many with a history connected to power.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. b. Determine the language demands of a writing or speaking situation; respond in appropriate ways (e.g., precise and concise language, extended and descriptive language, incorporation of code-meshing, etc.).
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. b. Notice the language demands of a writing/speaking situation (i.e. formal, informal) and respond in an appropriate way.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze the language demands of complex situations and shift my language, including code-meshing, on purpose.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can determine the language demands of a writing or speaking situation and respond in appropriate ways.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell if a situation is formal or informal and choose matching words with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can sort phrases into school talk and friend talk with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can notice whether a situation is formal or informal and respond in an appropriate way.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. c. Use verbs in the active and passive voice and in the conditional and subjunctive mood to achieve particular effects (e.g., emphasizing the actor or the action, expressing uncertainty, or describing a state contrary to fact).
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. c. Use to-be verbs (am, are, is, was, were, be, become, became) accurately when writing and communicating.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose active or passive voice and conditional or subjunctive mood on purpose and explain the effect.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use verbs in active and passive voice and in conditional and subjunctive mood to achieve particular effects.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can change a sentence from passive to active voice using a model.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use is, are and was correctly in a sentence with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use to-be verbs (am, are, is, was, were) correctly when writing and communicating.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Knowledge of Language
text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures, contexts, and disciplines; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. d. Begin to develop metacognitive awareness as writers and speakers by explaining the reasons for language choices.
ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. d. Begin to develop metacognitive awareness as writers and speakers by explaining the reasons for language choices.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can explain and evaluate my language choices in detail and revise them to better fit my purpose.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can begin to develop awareness of my language choices by explaining my reasons for them.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can explain one word choice I made using a sentence frame.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can point to a word I chose and say why with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can begin to explain the reasons for my language choices.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words or phrases in grade-level reading and content; use context clues, analyze meaningful word parts, consult general and specialized reference materials, and apply word solving strategies (for meaning) as appropriate. a. Verify the preliminary determination of the meaning of a word or phrase (e.g., by checking the inferred meaning in context or in a dictionary).
ee_text: Demonstrate knowledge of word meanings. a. Use context to determine which word is missing from a content area text.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can check a word's meaning with several strategies and explain which one was most reliable.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can verify my first guess about a word's meaning by checking context or a dictionary.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can guess a word's meaning from context and check it in a dictionary with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find a new word in a picture dictionary with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use context to work out which word is missing from a text.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words or phrases in grade-level reading and content; use context clues, analyze meaningful word parts, consult general and specialized reference materials, and apply word solving strategies (for meaning) as appropriate. b. Use grade-appropriate Greek or Latin affixes and roots as clues to the meaning of a word.
ee_text: Demonstrate knowledge of word meanings. b. Use frequently occurring root words (e.g., like) and the words that result when affixes are added (e.g., liked, disliked, liking). c. Seek clarification and meaning support when unfamiliar words are encountered while reading or communicating.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use Greek and Latin roots and affixes to work out and explain the meanings of complex academic words.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use grade-appropriate Greek or Latin affixes and roots as clues to a word's meaning.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find a known root or affix in a word and use a chart to guess its meaning.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find a small word I know inside a bigger word with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use root words and affixes to understand words and ask for help with unfamiliar words.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings. Determine the denotative, connotative, and figurative meanings of words and phrases used in texts; when words have similar denotations, be able to describe differences in connotation and their impact on meaning and tone. Analyze the impact of specific word choice on meaning and tone, including analogies or allusions to other texts.
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of word relationships and use. a. Identify the literal and nonliteral meanings of words in context. b. Use descriptive words to add meaning when writing and communicating.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can analyze how connotation, analogies and allusions work together to create meaning and tone.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can determine denotative, connotative and figurative meanings, describe connotation differences, and analyze how word choice, analogies and allusions affect meaning and tone.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can explain a simple analogy and tell whether a word feels positive or negative with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell whether a phrase means exactly what it says with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify literal and nonliteral meanings of words and use descriptive words to add meaning.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Vocabulary Acquisition & Use
text: Demonstrate an ability to collaboratively and independently build vocabulary knowledge when encountering unknown words including cultural, general academic, and discipline-specific terms and phrases; make intentional vocabulary choices appropriate to the context and situation.
ee_text: Use general academic and domain-specific words and phrases across contexts.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can independently build vocabulary and make intentional word choices for cultural, academic and subject contexts.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can build vocabulary with others and on my own, including cultural, academic and subject terms, and choose words that fit the situation.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use new academic words from a word wall in my speaking and writing with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can use a few key subject words with pictures and help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use general academic and subject-specific words across contexts.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English grammar and usage when writing or speaking. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose of language choice with: a. active and passive voice verbs;
ee_text: Demonstrate standardized English grammar and usage when communicating. a. Use appropriate verbs to match nouns.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can choose active or passive voice to control emphasis and explain why it fits my purpose.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use active and passive voice verbs correctly and explain their purpose.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can tell whether a sentence is active or passive using examples.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can say who is doing the action in a picture sentence with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use verbs that match their nouns.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English grammar and usage when writing or speaking. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose of language choice with: b. indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive mood verbs; and
ee_text: Demonstrate standardized English grammar and usage when communicating. b. Form and use the simple verb tenses (e.g., I walked, I walk, I will walk).

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use all five verb moods on purpose and explain how each changes meaning.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional and subjunctive mood verbs correctly and explain their purpose.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can sort sentences into statements, commands and questions using a chart.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell a statement from a question with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can form and use simple verb tenses (I walked, I walk, I will walk).

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English grammar and usage when writing or speaking. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose of language choice with: c. recognizing and correcting shifts in verb voice and mood.
ee_text: Not applicable

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can find and fix shifts in verb voice and mood in my own and others' writing and explain the confusion they cause.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can recognize and correct inappropriate shifts in verb voice and mood.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can fix a verb shift in a given sentence using a model.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can tell which of two sentences sounds right with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose in conventions with: a. punctuation to recognize a pause or break,
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of conventions of standardized English. a. Use end punctuation and capitalization when writing a sentence or question.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use commas, ellipses or dashes to show a pause or break on purpose and explain the effect.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use punctuation to show a pause or break and explain its purpose.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can add punctuation to show a pause in a sentence using examples.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find the punctuation marks in a sentence with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use end punctuation and capitals when writing a sentence or question.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose in conventions with: b. ellipsis to indicate an omission, and
ee_text: Not applicable

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use ellipses to show omissions in quotations and explain how they keep the original meaning.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use an ellipsis to show an omission and explain its purpose.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can use an ellipsis to shorten a quote using a model.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can find an ellipsis in a sentence with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Conventions of Standardized English
text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose in conventions with: c. correct spelling.
ee_text: Demonstrate understanding of conventions of standardized English. c. Spell words phonetically, drawing on knowledge of letter-sound relationships and/or common spelling patterns.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can spell grade-level and complex words correctly and use patterns and resources to check my spelling.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can spell correctly in my writing.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can spell common words correctly and use a word wall or spell-checker for others.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can spell my name and a few familiar words with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can spell words by using letter-sound relationships and common spelling patterns.

source: Wisconsin Standards for ELA (DPI 2020); Wisconsin Essential Elements for ELA (DPI 2022)

subject: ELA
cluster: Key Ideas & Details
text: Cite relevant textual evidence that strongly supports analysis of what the text says explicitly or implicitly and make logical inferences; develop questions for further exploration. (RI&RL)
ee_text: Determine which citations demonstrate what the text says explicitly as well as inferentially. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can cite highly relevant textual evidence to support deep analysis of explicit and implicit content and develop insightful questions for deeper understanding and further exploration.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can cite relevant textual evidence that strongly supports an analysis of what the text says explicitly or implicitly and make logical inferences; icluding develop questions for further exploration.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can find and cite evidence to support my understanding of explicit content in the text.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can determine the meaning of a text and cite textual evidence to draw inferences from the text.
I can use a graphic organizer such as a two-column chart with the headings, “What I Know” and “Facts”. Fill in the graphic organizer by using examples from text of “Facts” (e.g., “Steps are numbered, if I do #3 before I do #2, I don’t have the pieces I need.”) that support an inference “What I Know” (e.g., need to do steps in order).
I can While reading a historical text, infer what will happen next in the text using textual evidence to support the inference (e.g., The soldiers gathered on the battlefield supports an inference that there is going to be a fight).
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can determine which citations demonstrate what the text says explicitly as well as inferentially.
